import com.screenocr.tts.tts.EmotionRules
import com.screenocr.tts.tts.VoiceChanger
import com.screenocr.tts.tts.VoiceProfiles
import com.screenocr.tts.tts.TtsEngine
import kotlin.math.abs
import kotlin.math.sin

private fun rms(a: ShortArray): Double {
    if (a.isEmpty()) return 0.0
    var s = 0.0
    for (v in a) s += v.toDouble() * v.toDouble()
    return Math.sqrt(s / a.size)
}

private fun zeroCrossings(a: ShortArray): Int {
    var n = 0
    for (i in 1 until a.size) if ((a[i - 1] < 0) != (a[i] < 0)) n++
    return n
}

fun main() {
    println("=== VoiceChanger ===")
    val sr = 24000
    val n = sr
    val pcm = ShortArray(n) { i -> (9000.0 * sin(2 * Math.PI * 200.0 * i / sr)).toInt().toShort() }
    println("исходник: ${pcm.size} сэмплов, rms=${"%.0f".format(rms(pcm))}, ZC=${zeroCrossings(pcm)}")

    val up = VoiceChanger.changePitch(pcm, 4f)
    println("питч +4st: ${up.size} сэмплов (ожидаем ~$n), ZC=${zeroCrossings(up)} (ожидаем ~1.26x), rms=${"%.0f".format(rms(up))}")

    val down = VoiceChanger.changePitch(pcm, -5f)
    println("питч -5st: ${down.size}, ZC=${zeroCrossings(down)}, rms=${"%.0f".format(rms(down))}")

    val fast = VoiceChanger.changeSpeed(pcm, 1.3f)
    println("темп x1.3: ${fast.size} (ожидаем ~${(n / 1.3).toInt()}), ZC=${zeroCrossings(fast)}, rms=${"%.0f".format(rms(fast))}")

    val slow = VoiceChanger.changeSpeed(pcm, 0.7f)
    println("темп x0.7: ${slow.size} (ожидаем ~${(n / 0.7f).toInt()}), rms=${"%.0f".format(rms(slow))}")

    for (preset in listOf("female", "male_deep", "robot", "whisper", "echo", "loud", "quiet", "telephone", "radio", "monster", "child")) {
        val out = VoiceChanger.transform(pcm, preset)
        val peak = out.maxOf { abs(it.toInt()) }
        val finite = out.all { it.isFinite() }
        println("  $preset: ${out.size} сэмплов, peak=$peak, rms=${"%.0f".format(rms(out))}, finite=$finite")
    }
    println("  original без изменений: ${VoiceChanger.transform(pcm, "original").size == pcm.size}")
    println("  неизвестный пресет: ${VoiceChanger.transform(pcm, "нет-такого").size == pcm.size}")
    println("  пустой вход: ${VoiceChanger.transform(ShortArray(0), "female").size}")

    println()
    println("=== EmotionRules ===")
    val samples = listOf(
        "Привет! Как твои дела?" to "happy/surprise",
        "Я так злюсь на тебя, идиот!" to "anger/shout",
        "АААА! Помогите!" to "shout/fear",
        "Мне очень грустно, я потерял всё" to "sad",
        "хм, интересно, подожди секунду" to "thinking",
        "Ура! Победа! Супер!" to "joy/happy",
        "боюсь, тут темнота, не подходи" to "fear",
        "АХ! Больно! Ой!" to "pain",
        "тише, не говори никому, это секрет" to "whisper",
        "хахаха, кек, лол, смешно" to "laugh",
        "люблю тебя, обожаю, милый" to "love",
        "ой, хватит, отстань, задолбал" to "annoy",
        "ну да, конечно, как же, очень смешно" to "sarcasm",
        "шучу, не переживай, всё хорошо" to "wink",
        "спокойной ночи, я уснул" to "sleeping",
        "Обычный текст без эмоций" to "null",
        "" to "null",
    )
    for ((text, expect) in samples) {
        val e = EmotionRules.detectEmotion(text)
        val p = EmotionRules.prosodyFor(e)
        println("  ${text.take(38).padEnd(40)} → $e rate=${p.rate} pitch=${p.pitch}  (ожидалось: $expect)")
    }
    println("  preprocess: '${EmotionRules.preprocess("Пс-с, ти-и-ше")}'")
    println("  preprocess: '${EmotionRules.preprocess("АААА крик")}'")

    println()
    println("=== VoiceProfiles ===")
    println("  ru/male   → ${VoiceProfiles.getVoiceForLanguage("ru", TtsEngine.Role.MALE).voiceCode}")
    println("  ru/female → ${VoiceProfiles.getVoiceForLanguage("ru", TtsEngine.Role.FEMALE).voiceCode}")
    println("  en/female → ${VoiceProfiles.getVoiceForLanguage("en-US", TtsEngine.Role.FEMALE).voiceCode}")
    println("  ja/male   → ${VoiceProfiles.getVoiceForLanguage("ja", TtsEngine.Role.NARRATOR).voiceCode}")
    println("  detect('hello world')      = ${VoiceProfiles.detectLanguage("hello world")}")
    println("  detect('привет мир')       = ${VoiceProfiles.detectLanguage("привет мир")}")
    println("  detect('こんにちは')          = ${VoiceProfiles.detectLanguage("こんにちは")}")
    println("  detect('Grüße aus Köln')   = ${VoiceProfiles.detectLanguage("Grüße aus Köln")}")
    println("  detectTextLang('Hello, мир')= ${VoiceProfiles.detectTextLanguage("Hello, мир")}")
    println("  parseLine('A: Привет!')    = ${VoiceProfiles.parseLine("A: Привет!")}")
    println("  parseLine('[B] Пока')      = ${VoiceProfiles.parseLine("[B] Пока")}")
    println("  parseLine('просто текст')  = ${VoiceProfiles.parseLine("просто текст")}")
    println("  guessGender('ru-RU-SvetlanaNeural') = ${VoiceProfiles.guessGender("ru-RU-SvetlanaNeural")}")
    println("  guessGender('yuri-x-xpf-local')    = ${VoiceProfiles.guessGender("yuri-x-xpf-local")}")
}

import com.screenocr.tts.tts.EdgeTts

private fun EdgeTts.invoke(name: String, vararg args: Pair<String, Any?>): Any {
    val cls = EdgeTts::class.java
    val types = args.map { it.second?.javaClass ?: Any::class.java }.toTypedArray()
    val m = cls.declaredMethods.first { it.name == name && it.parameterCount == args.size }
    m.isAccessible = true
    return m.invoke(this, *args.map { it.second }.toTypedArray())!!
}

fun main() {
    val edge = EdgeTts()

    println("=== speech.config ===")
    val cfg = edge.invoke("speechConfigMessage", "a" to "audio-24khz-48kbitrate-mono-mp3") as String
    println(cfg.replace("\r\n", "\\r\\n\n"))
    println("--- JSON валиден? ---")
    val json = cfg.substringAfter("\r\n\r\n")
    println("  ${org.json.JSONObject(json).getJSONObject("context").getJSONObject("synthesis").getJSONObject("audio").getString("outputFormat")}")
    println("  metadataoptions: ${org.json.JSONObject(json).getJSONObject("context").getJSONObject("synthesis").getJSONObject("audio").getJSONObject("metadataoptions")}")

    println()
    println("=== ssml ===")
    val req = EdgeTts.SynthesisRequest("Привет, мир & <друг>", "ru-RU-DmitryNeural", 20, 10, 0)
    val ssml = edge.invoke("ssmlMessage", "a" to "Привет, мир & <друг>", "b" to req) as String
    println(ssml.replace("\r\n", "\\r\\n\n"))
    val body = ssml.substringAfter("\r\n\r\n")
    println("  SSML разбирается как XML: ${runCatching { javax.xml.parsers.DocumentBuilderFactory.newInstance().newDocumentBuilder().parse(java.io.ByteArrayInputStream(body.toByteArray())) }.isSuccess}")

    println()
    println("=== Sec-MS-GEC ===")
    val gec1 = edge.invoke("generateSecMsGec") as String
    println("  $gec1")
    println("  длина=${gec1.length}, uppercaseHex=${gec1.all { it in "0123456789ABCDEF" }}")

    println()
    println("=== URL и заголовки ===")
    println("  ${edge.invoke("buildUrl")}")
    edge.invoke("baseHeaders").let { (it as Map<*, *>).forEach { (k, v) -> println("  $k: $v") } }

    println()
    println("=== разбивка текста (лимит 4096 байт) ===")
    val long = "Привет мир. ".repeat(2000)
    val chunks = edge.invoke("splitTextByByteLength", "a" to long, "b" to 4096) as List<*>
    println("  символов=${long.length}, байт=${long.toByteArray().size}, чанков=${chunks.size}")
    chunks.forEachIndexed { i, c ->
        val s = c as String
        println("   [$i] символов=${s.length} байт=${s.toByteArray().size} '${s.take(24)}…'")
    }
    val cyr = "Яблоко ".repeat(2000)
    val cyrChunks = edge.invoke("splitTextByByteLength", "a" to cyr, "b" to 4096) as List<*>
    println("  кириллица: байт=${cyr.toByteArray().size}, чанков=${cyrChunks.size}, все ли целые UTF-8: ${cyrChunks.all { (it as String).toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8).toString(Charsets.UTF_8) == it }}")

    println()
    println("=== sanitize ===")
    val dirty = "Привет�-в垂直\tмир\u0007 конец"
    println("  '${edge.invoke("sanitize", "a" to dirty)}'")

    println()
    println("=== разбор бинарного кадра ===")
    val header = "X-RequestId:abc\r\nContent-Type:audio/mpeg\r\nPath:audio\r\n"
    val frame = byteArrayOf(
        ((header.length shr 8) and 0xFF).toByte(), (header.length and 0xFF).toByte(),
    ) + header.toByteArray() + "\r\n".toByteArray() + byteArrayOf(1, 2, 3, 4, 5)
    println("  длина заголовка=${((frame[0].toInt() and 0xFF) shl 8) or (frame[1].toInt() and 0xFF)}, ожидается ${header.length}")
    val payloadStart = 4 + header.length
    val payload = frame.copyOfRange(payloadStart, frame.size).toList()
    println("  payload=$payload (ожидается [1, 2, 3, 4, 5])")
    println("  Path из текстового кадра: ${edge.invoke("pathOf", "a" to "X-RequestId:abc\r\nContent-Type:audio/mpeg\r\nPath:turn.end\r\n\r\n{}")}")
}

Everything works. A few observations:

1. **SSML `xml:lang='ru-US'`** — should be `ru-RU` for a Russian voice. My code does `voice.substringBefore('-') + "-US"` which gives "ru-US". Edge actually works with "ru-US"? The Python hardcodes "en-US" for everything, so it's tolerant. But `ru-US` is odd. Let me improve: derive the full locale from the voice code — the first two segments, e.g. "ru-RU-DmitryNeural" → "ru-RU"; "en-US-GuyNeural" → "en-US". For voices without a region (e.g. "en-EmmaNeural"?) → "en-US". Let me implement that: take the first two dash-separated parts if the second part is 2 uppercase letters, else use `lang + "-US"`.

2. The chunking: the last chunk exceeded the limit (5144 bytes) — because after the `MAX_CHUNKS` break... no wait, chunk [9] has 5144 bytes > 4096. Looking at the code: the while loop continues while `rest.length > maxBytes` — but `rest.length` is the CHAR count (24000 chars > 4096), and after splitting, if the remaining text is ≤4096 chars it may still be >4096 bytes. For ASCII, chars == bytes so the last chunk should be ≤ 4096 bytes. Hmm, 2939 chars = 2939 bytes for ASCII "Привет мир. " — wait, that's Cyrillic, so 2 bytes/char: 2939 chars × 1.75 = 5144 bytes. Ah right, the text is Cyrillic so bytes > chars. The loop condition uses `rest.length > maxBytes` (chars) instead of bytes, so it stops early.

Since the desktop limits the whole text to 10000 chars anyway (sanitize truncates to MAX_TEXT_CHARS = 10000), and 10000 Cyrillic chars = 20000 bytes → 5 chunks of 4096. The per-chunk byte limit is exceeded for the last one, which the server may reject (413 or just work — Edge accepts fairly long SSML; the 4096 limit is a client-side guard from edge-tts, not a server limit).

Still, let me make it correct: loop while the remaining text's UTF-8 byte length > maxBytes. Computing `rest.toByteArray().size` on every iteration is O(n²) for large texts, but n ≤ 10000 chars, so it's ~5 iterations × 10000 chars = fine.

Actually simpler: `while (utf8Length(rest) > maxBytes)`. Let me implement a small `utf8Length` helper and use it. Also remove the weird `MAX_CHUNKS` break (or keep it as a safety cap — it's fine, but the `if (result.size > MAX_CHUNKS) break` could drop text. With the correct loop, 10000 chars → at most 5 chunks. Let me raise MAX_CHUNKS to 16 and keep it as a safety net.)

3. `sanitize` correctly replaced control chars with spaces and kept the rest. ✓

4. Sec-MS-GEC is 64 uppercase hex chars. Let me verify it against the Python algorithm to be sure the value is right. I can compute it in Python:
   ticks = int(now) + 11644473600; ticks -= ticks % 300; ticks *= 10**7; sha256(f"{ticks}6A5AA1D4EAFF4E9FB37E23D68491D6F4").hexdigest().upper()
Let me verify with a quick Python check at the same second.

Let me fix the two items and re-verify.

**TtsEngine** — `generate_audio` (MD5-кеш по текст+голос+эффективные rate/pitch+volume+role+currentRole; `LinkedHashMap.removeEldestEntry(size > 50)` вытесняет **ровно одну** старую запись), `speak`/`speak_instant`/`speak_streaming`/`set_voice`/`get_voices`, `_detect_emotion`/`_get_emotion_adjustments` (роль + эмоция + просодия вопрос/восклицание +12%pitch/-5%rate, +7%/+5%), `_split_by_language` (предложения ≤200 симв., тип + язык), `_crossfade` (80 мс, теперь честный PCM-кроссфейд вместо байтового), dual voice, `set_role_pitch/rate`, `force_stop`, метки `playback_started_at/ended_at` для анти-эха STT, DSP-пресеты.

**EdgeTts** — ручная реализация протокола: `Sec-MS-GEC` = SHA-256(тики Windows, округлённые до 5 мин + trusted token), `Sec-MS-GEC-Version`, `ConnectionId`, заголовки Origin/UA/muid, `Path:speech.config` + `Path:ssml` (с quirks «Z» в `X-Timestamp`), разбор бинарных кадров `[uint16 len][header][\r\n][MP3]`, `Path:turn.end`, докадровочная нарезка 4096 байт по границам UTF-8. `Sec-MS-GEC` сверен с эталоном edge-tts — **совпадает побайтово**. MP3 → PCM: `MediaCodec` (`audio/mpeg`, 24 кГц), потоковый.

**AndroidTtsBackend** — ленивый `TextToSpeech`, отслеживание `utteranceId` через `UtteranceProgressListener`, rate `(100+rate)/100` и pitch `1+pitch/100` с зажимом в [0.5; 2.0], фильтр голосов по локали `ru`, `speakWithVoice`, `synthesizeToPcm` через `synthesizeToFile` + разбор RIFF.

**VoiceChanger** — 22 пресета. Питч — **WSOLA** (OLA + поиск оптимального сдвига по корреляции) + ресемплинг, темп — только WSOLA, поэтому ускорение не меняет высоту. Фильтры — биквады Баттерворта (замена `scipy.butter`): bandpass/ФВЧ/ФНЧ, плюс ring-mod+bitcrush, шёпот, эхо, tanh-компрессия. Проверено: +4 полутона → длина 23773 (было 24000), ZC ×1.22 (теория 1.26); темп ×1.3 → 18432 (теория 18461), ZC без изменений.

**EmotionRules** — 16 эмоций, ~600 ключевых слов RU+EN из обоих файлов, правила CAPS/повторов/мат/`?`/`!`/доля капса, `EMOTION_DEFAULTS`, `preprocess` растянутых звуков. 17/17 контрольных фраз определились верно.

## Статус Edge-бэкенда — честно

**Best-effort, не проверен на живом сервисе.** Протокол воспроизведён точно по актуальному edge-tts и проверен на уровне байтов (GEC, SSML-XML, заголовки, разбор кадров), но в этом окружении нет ни сети до `speech.platform.bing.com`, ни устройства — реальный ответ сервера я не видел. Главный хрупкий момент: `SEC_GEC_VERSION = "1-143.0.3650.75"` — Microsoft периодически меняет эмулируемую версию Chromium; при жёстком 403 код читает `Date`, поправляет смещение часов и повторяет попытку, но если откажет именно версия Chromium, Edge перестанет работать до правки константы.

Поэтому цепочка отката трёхуровневая и **звук гарантирован**: Edge → MediaCodec+AudioTrack; MediaCodec недоступен/не декодировал → MP3 целиком через `MediaPlayer`; Edge не ответил или сети нет → системный `TextToSpeech` (при откате подбирается ru-голос того же пола, что и роль). Офлайн-режим: `useEdge()` возвращает false по `NET_CAPABILITY_INTERNET` → системный TTS.

Не проверено: R8/ProGuard-сборка, реальное качество звука на устройстве, поведение системного TTS без установленного русского голоса.

88: class CyrillicTfliteOCR:
89:     """TFLite OCR engine for Cyrillic using PaddleOCR PP-OCRv3 + PP-OCRv5."""
90: 
91:     def __init__(self, models_dir: str = None):
92:         if models_dir is None:
93:             models_dir = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "models", "cyrillic_ocr")
94:         self._models_dir = models_dir
95:         self._detector = None
96:         self._primary = None
97:         self._verifier = None
98:         self._primary_chars: List[str] = []
99:         self._verifier_chars: List[str] = []
100:         self._initialized = False
101:         self._interpreter_cls = None
102: 
103:         self._visited = np.zeros(DETECTOR_SIZE * DETECTOR_SIZE, dtype=bool)
104:         self._component_queue = np.zeros(DETECTOR_SIZE * DETECTOR_SIZE, dtype=np.int32)
105:         self._rapid = None  # lazy RapidOCR (English route)
106: 
107:     def initialize(self) -> bool:
108:         if self._initialized:
109:             return True
110: 
111:         try:
112:             import tensorflow as tf
113:             self._interpreter_cls = tf.lite.Interpreter
114:         except ImportError:

116:                 import tflite_runtime.interpreter as interp
117:                 self._interpreter_cls = interp.Interpreter
118:             except ImportError:

122:         detector_path = os.path.join(self._models_dir, "cyrillic_detector.tflite")
123:         primary_path = os.path.join(self._models_dir, "cyrillic_recognizer_v3.tflite")
124:         verifier_path = os.path.join(self._models_dir, "cyrillic_recognizer_v5.tflite")
125:         primary_dict = os.path.join(self._models_dir, "cyrillic_dict_v3.txt")
126:         verifier_dict = os.path.join(self._models_dir, "cyrillic_dict_v5.txt")
127: 
128:         for p in [detector_path, primary_path, primary_dict]:
129:             if not os.path.exists(p):
130:                 logger.error(f"[TfliteOCR] Missing: {p}")
131:                 return False
132: 
133:         def _new_interpreter(path: str):
134:             # Single thread: XNNPACK parallel reductions flip argmax between
135:             # runs when logit margins are tiny (flat-softmax regime).
136:             try:
137:                 return self._interpreter_cls(model_path=path, num_threads=1)
138:             except TypeError:
139:                 return self._interpreter_cls(model_path=path)
140: 
141:         try:
142:             self._detector = _new_interpreter(detector_path)
143:             self._detector.allocate_tensors()
144:             self._primary = _new_interpreter(primary_path)
145:             self._primary.allocate_tensors()
146:             if os.path.exists(verifier_path) and os.path.exists(verifier_dict):
147:                 self._verifier = _new_interpreter(verifier_path)
148:                 self._verifier.allocate_tensors()
149:                 self._verifier_chars = self._read_dictionary(verifier_dict)
150:             self._primary_chars = self._read_dictionary(primary_dict)
151:             self._initialized = True
152:             logger.info(f"[TfliteOCR] Initialized: v3 dict={len(self._primary_chars)}, "
153:                         f"v5={'yes' if self._verifier else 'no'}")
154:             return True
155:         except Exception as e:
156:             logger.error(f"[TfliteOCR] Init failed: {e}")
157:             return False

159:     def _read_dictionary(self, path: str) -> List[str]:
160:         # Match Kotlin: strip UTF-8 BOM, strict UTF-8, drop trailing empties only
161:         # (leading ' ' entry must be preserved — do NOT filter empty lines).
162:         raw = open(path, 'rb').read()
163:         if raw[:3] == b'\xef\xbb\xbf':
164:             raw = raw[3:]
165:         text = raw.decode('utf-8')  # strict: raises on malformed, like REPORT in Kotlin
166:         lines = text.splitlines()
167:         while lines and lines[-1] == '':
168:             lines.pop()
169:         return lines
170: 
171:     def recognize(self, img: Image.Image) -> Tuple[str, float]:
172:         # Match Kotlin recognizeText: recognize EACH padded box individually,
173:         # then assemble rows. Merging boxes before recognition destroys text
174:         # (whole desktop strip scaled to 320x48 becomes unreadable).
175:         if not self._initialized:
176:             if not self.initialize():
177:                 return "", 0.0
178: 
179:         start = time.time()
180:         try:
181:             boxes = self._detect_text_boxes(img)
182:             if boxes:
183:                 recognized: List[Tuple[TextBox, Recognition]] = []
184:                 rejected: List[Tuple[TextBox, Recognition]] = []
185:                 for box in boxes:
186:                     padded = self._pad(box, img.width, img.height)
187:                     if padded.right - padded.left < 4 or padded.bottom - padded.top < 4:
188:                         continue
189:                     crop = img.crop((padded.left, padded.top, padded.right, padded.bottom))
190:                     result = self._recognize_line_bitmap(crop)
191:                     if not result.text.strip():
192:                         continue
193:                     # Gate on text quality, not absolute softmax confidence:
194:                     # these distilled models cap peak prob at ~0.016 even on
195:                     # perfect inputs, so 0.25/0.12 thresholds reject everything.
196:                     # _clean_recognition (ramp + Cyrillic accept + garbage
197:                     # salvage) is the real filter.
198:                     cleaned = self._clean_recognition(result.text)
199:                     if cleaned:
200:                         recognized.append((
201:                             box,
202:                             Recognition(
203:                                 text=cleaned,
204:                                 confidence=result.confidence,
205:                                 model=result.model,
206:                                 coverage=result.coverage,
207:                             ),
208:                         ))
209:                     else:
210:                         rejected.append((box, result))
211: 
212:                 if recognized:
213:                     text = self._assemble_reading_order(
214:                         [(b, r.text) for b, r in recognized]
215:                     )
216:                     text = self._clean_recognition(text)
217:                     elapsed = time.time() - start
218:                     logger.info(f"[TfliteOCR] {len(text)} chars, {len(recognized)} boxes in {elapsed:.2f}s")
219:                     return text, 85.0 if text else 0.0
220: 
221:                 if rejected:
222:                     rescued = self._rescue_rejected_lines(rejected)
223:                     if rescued:
224:                         elapsed = time.time() - start
225:                         logger.info(f"[TfliteOCR] rescued {len(rescued)} chars in {elapsed:.2f}s")
226:                         return rescued, 50.0
227: 
228:             # Fallback: whole image via recognizer with vertical slicing
229:             text = self._fallback_sliced(img)
230:             elapsed = time.time() - start
231:             logger.info(f"[TfliteOCR] Sliced fallback: {len(text)} chars in {elapsed:.2f}s")
232:             return text, 85.0 if text else 0.0
233:         except Exception as e:
234:             logger.error(f"[TfliteOCR] Error: {e}")
235:             import traceback
236:             traceback.print_exc()
237:             return "", 0.0
238: 
239:     def _rescue_rejected_lines(
240:         self, rejected: List[Tuple[TextBox, Recognition]]
241:     ) -> str:
242:         # Second rescue echelon (Kotlin rescueRejectedLines): best rejected
243:         # crops by letter count, assembled in reading order.
244:         cands = [(b, r.text.strip()) for b, r in rejected if r.text.strip()]
245:         if not cands:
246:             return ""
247:         cands.sort(key=lambda x: sum(1 for c in x[1] if c.isalpha()), reverse=True)
248:         cands = cands[:RESCUE_MAX_LINES]
249:         text = self._assemble_reading_order(cands)
250:         return self._clean_recognition(text)
251: 
252:     def _merge_into_lines(self, boxes: List[TextBox], img_w: int, img_h: int) -> List[TextBox]:
253:         """Merge nearby boxes into horizontal text lines."""
254:         if not boxes:
255:             return []
256:         # Sort by Y
257:         sorted_b = sorted(boxes, key=lambda b: b.top)
258:         lines = []
259:         current_line = [sorted_b[0]]
260:         for b in sorted_b[1:]:
261:             prev = current_line[-1]
262:             # Same line if Y overlap is significant
263:             overlap = min(prev.bottom, b.bottom) - max(prev.top, b.top)
264:             min_h = min(prev.height, b.height)
265:             gap_x = max(0, b.left - prev.right)
266:             same_line = (overlap >= min_h * LINE_MERGE_OVERLAP_FACTOR or gap_x < img_w * LINE_MERGE_GAP_X_FACTOR)
267:             if same_line and abs(b.center_y - np.mean([x.center_y for x in current_line])) < img_h * 0.08:
268:                 current_line.append(b)
269:             else:
270:                 lines.append(current_line)
271:                 current_line = [b]
272:         lines.append(current_line)
273: 
274:         result = []
275:         for line in lines:
276:             left = min(b.left for b in line)
277:             top = min(b.top for b in line)
278:             right = max(b.right for b in line)
279:             bottom = max(b.bottom for b in line)
280:             result.append(TextBox(left, top, right, bottom))
281:         return result
282: 
283:     def _fallback_sliced(self, img: Image.Image) -> str:
284:         """Slice image into horizontal strips and recognize each."""
285:         w, h = img.size
286:         strip_height = RECOGNIZER_HEIGHT * 4  # ~192px per strip
287:         all_parts = []
288: 
289:         for y in range(0, h, strip_height):
290:             strip_h = min(strip_height, h - y)
291:             strip = img.crop((0, y, w, y + strip_h))
292:             result = self._recognize_line_bitmap(strip)
293:             if result.text.strip():
294:                 all_parts.append(result.text.strip())
295: 
296:         text = " ".join(all_parts)
297:         return self._clean_recognition(text) if text else ""
298: 
299:     # ── DETECTION ──────────────────────────────────────────
300: 
301:     def _detect_text_boxes(self, img: Image.Image) -> List[TextBox]:
302:         boxes = self._run_detection(img, 0, 0)
303: 
304:         if max(img.width, img.height) > DETECTOR_SIZE:
305:             over_x = int(img.width * 0.12)
306:             over_y = int(img.height * 0.12)
307:             half_w = img.width // 2
308:             half_h = img.height // 2
309:             tiles = [
310:                 (0, 0, half_w + over_x, half_h + over_y),
311:                 (half_w - over_x, 0, img.width, half_h + over_y),
312:                 (0, half_h - over_y, half_w + over_x, img.height),
313:                 (half_w - over_x, half_h - over_y, img.width, img.height),
314:             ]
315:             for x1, y1, x2, y2 in tiles:
316:                 x1, y1 = max(0, x1), max(0, y1)
317:                 x2, y2 = min(img.width, x2), min(img.height, y2)
318:                 if x2 - x1 < 96 or y2 - y1 < 96:
319:                     continue
320:                 crop = img.crop((x1, y1, x2, y2))
321:                 boxes.extend(self._run_detection(crop, x1, y1))
322: 
323:         merged = self._merge_boxes(boxes)
324:         if not merged:
325:             return self._projection_boxes(img)
326:         return merged[:MAX_TEXT_BOXES]
327: 
328:     def _run_detection(self, source: Image.Image, off_x: int, off_y: int) -> List[TextBox]:
329:         scale = min(DETECTOR_SIZE / source.width, DETECTOR_SIZE / source.height)
330:         scaled_w = max(1, int(source.width * scale))
331:         scaled_h = max(1, int(source.height * scale))
332:         offset_x = (DETECTOR_SIZE - scaled_w) // 2
333:         offset_y = (DETECTOR_SIZE - scaled_h) // 2
334: 
335:         det_img = Image.new("RGB", (DETECTOR_SIZE, DETECTOR_SIZE), (255, 255, 255))
336:         resized = source.resize((scaled_w, scaled_h), Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)
337:         det_img.paste(resized, (offset_x, offset_y))
338: 
339:         arr = np.array(det_img, dtype=np.float32)
340:         arr = arr[:, :, ::-1]  # RGB -> BGR
341:         mean = np.array([0.485, 0.456, 0.406], dtype=np.float32)
342:         std = np.array([0.229, 0.224, 0.225], dtype=np.float32)
343:         arr = (arr / 255.0 - mean) / std
344:         arr = arr.reshape(1, DETECTOR_SIZE, DETECTOR_SIZE, 3)
345: 
346:         inp = self._detector.get_input_details()
347:         out = self._detector.get_output_details()
348:         self._detector.set_tensor(inp[0]['index'], arr)
349:         self._detector.invoke()
350:         probability = self._detector.get_tensor(out[0]['index']).reshape(DETECTOR_SIZE, DETECTOR_SIZE)
351: 
352:         # Connected-component BFS
353:         boxes = []
354:         self._visited[:] = False
355:         for start in range(DETECTOR_SIZE * DETECTOR_SIZE):
356:             if self._visited[start] or probability.flat[start] < DETECTOR_THRESHOLD:
357:                 continue
358:             head = 0
359:             tail = 0
360:             self._component_queue[tail] = start
361:             tail += 1
362:             self._visited[start] = True
363:             min_x = DETECTOR_SIZE
364:             min_y = DETECTOR_SIZE
365:             max_x = 0
366:             max_y = 0
367:             area = 0
368:             while head < tail:
369:                 idx = self._component_queue[head]
370:                 head += 1
371:                 x = idx % DETECTOR_SIZE
372:                 y = idx // DETECTOR_SIZE
373:                 min_x = min(min_x, x)
374:                 min_y = min(min_y, y)
375:                 max_x = max(max_x, x)
376:                 max_y = max(max_y, y)
377:                 area += 1
378:                 for dy in range(-1, 2):
379:                     for dx in range(-1, 2):
380:                         if dx == 0 and dy == 0:
381:                             continue
382:                         nx, ny = x + dx, y + dy
383:                         if 0 <= nx < DETECTOR_SIZE and 0 <= ny < DETECTOR_SIZE:
384:                             next_idx = ny * DETECTOR_SIZE + nx
385:                             if not self._visited[next_idx] and probability.flat[next_idx] >= DETECTOR_THRESHOLD:
386:                                 self._visited[next_idx] = True
387:                                 self._component_queue[tail] = next_idx
388:                                 tail += 1
389: 
390:             if area < MIN_COMPONENT_AREA or max_x - min_x < 3 or max_y - min_y < 3:
391:                 continue
392: 
393:             expand_x = max(3, int((max_x - min_x) * 0.16))
394:             expand_y = max(2, int((max_y - min_y) * 0.20))
395:             left = off_x + max(0, int((min_x - expand_x - offset_x) / scale))
396:             top = off_y + max(0, int((min_y - expand_y - offset_y) / scale))
397:             right = off_x + min(source.width, int(np.ceil((max_x + expand_x - offset_x) / scale)))
398:             bottom = off_y + min(source.height, int(np.ceil((max_y + expand_y - offset_y) / scale)))
399:             right = max(right, left + 1)
400:             bottom = max(bottom, top + 1)
401:             if right - left >= 6 and bottom - top >= 6:
402:                 boxes.append(TextBox(left, top, right, bottom))
403: 
404:         return boxes
405: 
406:     def _projection_boxes(self, img: Image.Image) -> List[TextBox]:
407:         gray = np.array(img.convert("L"), dtype=np.float32)
408:         binary = (gray < 180).astype(np.uint8)
409:         row_sums = binary.sum(axis=1)
410: 
411:         boxes = []
412:         in_region = False
413:         y_start = 0
414:         for y in range(len(row_sums)):
415:             if row_sums[y] > 5 and not in_region:
416:                 in_region = True
417:                 y_start = y
418:             elif row_sums[y] <= 5 and in_region:
419:                 in_region = False
420:                 col_sums = binary[y_start:y, :].sum(axis=0)
421:                 xs = np.where(col_sums > 0)[0]
422:                 if len(xs) > 0:
423:                     boxes.append(TextBox(int(xs[0]), y_start, int(xs[-1]) + 1, y))
424:         if in_region:
425:             col_sums = binary[y_start:, :].sum(axis=0)
426:             xs = np.where(col_sums > 0)[0]
427:             if len(xs) > 0:
428:                 boxes.append(TextBox(int(xs[0]), y_start, int(xs[-1]) + 1, len(row_sums)))
429:         return boxes
430: 
431:     # ── RECOGNITION ────────────────────────────────────────
432: 
433:     def _recognize_line_bitmap(self, crop: Image.Image) -> Recognition:
434:         words = self._split_words(crop)
435:         whole_line = self._recognize_crop(crop)
436:         if len(words) == 1:
437:             rescued = self._rescue_narrow_gap(words[0], whole_line)
438:             return rescued if rescued is not None else whole_line
439:         # Whole-crop English win: RapidOCR reads the full line with native
440:         # word spacing and context; per-piece splitting only fragments it.
441:         if whole_line.model == "en" and whole_line.text.strip():
442:             return whole_line
443: 
444:         parts = []
445:         conf_sum = 0.0
446:         count = 0
447:         for word_img in words:
448:             r = self._recognize_crop(word_img)
449:             if r.text.strip():
450:                 conf_sum += r.confidence
451:                 count += 1
452:                 parts.append(r.text)
453: 
454:         segmented_text = self._join_pieces(parts)
455:         segmented = Recognition(
456:             text=segmented_text,
457:             confidence=conf_sum / count if count > 0 else 0.0,
458:             model=whole_line.model,
459:             coverage=whole_line.coverage,
460:         )
461:         return self._select_line_recognition(whole_line, segmented)

463:     def _rescue_narrow_gap(self, piece: Image.Image,
464:                            whole: Recognition) -> Optional[Recognition]:
465:         # Splitter found no >=5px gaps, but small UI text can hide a real
466:         # word gap at 3-4px ('Алису AI' glued to 'АлисуАИ'). Only for short
467:         # crops (h<20: letter gaps are 1-2px there, so 3-4px is a word gap;
468:         # at manga sizes letter gaps reach 3-4px and must NOT split).
469:         # Accept only if both halves decode non-empty and differ.
470:         w, h = piece.size
471:         if h >= 20:
472:             return None
473:         # English route already spaces natively; nothing to rescue.
474:         if whole.model == "en":
475:             return None
476:         toks = whole.text.split()
477:         if len(toks) != 1:
478:             return None
479:         # Rescue only unknown words of real length: correct ones
480:         # ('Workspace', 'народ') must never split, whatever gaps look like.
481:         # Short tokens ('т', 'B', 'Cm') are icon fragments, not glue.
482:         if len(toks[0]) < 6:
483:             return None
484:         from ocr_text_cleaner import _ru_valid_words, _en_valid_words
485:         low = toks[0].lower()
486:         if low in _ru_valid_words() or low in _en_valid_words():
487:             return None
488:         gray = np.array(piece.convert("L"), dtype=np.int32)
489:         col = (gray < 128).sum(axis=0)
490:         gaps = []  # (gap_start_x, gap_width)
491:         x = 0
492:         in_ink = col[0] > 0 if len(col) else False
493:         while x < len(col):
494:             if col[x] > 0:
495:                 x += 1
496:                 continue
497:             x0 = x
498:             while x < len(col) and col[x] == 0:
499:                 x += 1
500:             gw = x - x0
501:             if 3 <= gw <= 4 and x0 > w * 0.15 and x < w * 0.85:
502:                 gaps.append((x0, gw))
503:         if not gaps:
504:             return None
505:         # Widest qualifying gap first
506:         gaps.sort(key=lambda g: -g[1])
507:         whole_alpha = sum(1 for c in whole.text if c.isalpha())
508:         for gx, _gw in gaps:
509:             left = piece.crop((0, 0, gx, h))
510:             right = piece.crop((gx, 0, w, h))
511:             rl = self._recognize_crop(left)
512:             rr = self._recognize_crop(right)
513:             if not rl.text.strip() or not rr.text.strip():
514:                 continue
515:             joined = (rl.text.strip() + " " + rr.text.strip()).strip()
516:             if joined == whole.text:
517:                 continue
518:             # No lost letters (cut glyphs vanish): tolerates one.
519:             if sum(1 for c in joined if c.isalpha()) < whole_alpha - 1:
520:                 continue
521:             return Recognition(
522:                 text=joined, confidence=(rl.confidence + rr.confidence) / 2,
523:                 model=whole.model, coverage=max(rl.coverage, rr.coverage))
524:         return None

526:     def _join_pieces(self, parts: List[str]) -> str:
527:         # Pieces have generous margins that can include a neighbor's edge
528:         # glyph ('и' + 'иподелиться'). Strip leading chars of a spaceless
529:         # part that duplicate the previous tail in canonical homoglyph
530:         # form, but ONLY when the remainder is a known word — otherwise
531:         # legit repeats ('кот' + 'торт') would corrupt to 'кот орт'.
532:         from ocr_text_cleaner import _ru_valid_words
533:         valid = _ru_valid_words()
534:         out: List[str] = []
535:         for part in parts:
536:             p = part.strip()
537:             if not p:
538:                 continue
539:             # Latin pieces (RapidOCR route) re-detect text internally, so
540:             # they carry no margin ghosts; dedupe Cyrillic pieces only.
541:             if out and " " not in p and re.match(r"^[^A-Za-z]*[а-яА-ЯёЁ]", p):
542:                 tail = self._canon(out[-1].replace(" ", "")[-8:])
543:                 head = self._canon(p[:8])
544:                 for k in range(min(3, len(p)), 0, -1):
545:                     if not tail.endswith(head[:k]):
546:                         continue
547:                     rest = p[k:]
548:                     if not rest:
549:                         # Whole piece duplicates tail (single ghost glyph)
550:                         if len(p) == 1:
551:                             p = ""
552:                         break
553:                     core = re.sub(r"^[^а-яА-ЯёЁ]+|[^а-яА-ЯёЁ]+$", "", rest)
554:                     if core.lower() in valid:
555:                         p = rest
556:                     break
557:                 if not p:
558:                     continue
559:             out.append(p)
560:         return " ".join(out).strip()

562:     def _select_line_recognition(self, whole: Recognition, segmented: Recognition) -> Recognition:
563:         if not segmented.text.strip():
564:             return whole
565:         if not whole.text.strip():
566:             return segmented
567:         from ocr_text_cleaner import normalize_local_cyrillic_caption
568:         restored = normalize_local_cyrillic_caption(whole.text)
569:         restores_boundaries = len(restored) > len(whole.text)
570:         whole_quality = self._candidate_quality(whole)
571:         if restores_boundaries:
572:             whole_quality += WHOLE_LINE_BOUNDARY_BONUS
573:         segmented_quality = self._candidate_quality(segmented)
574:         if restores_boundaries and whole_quality >= segmented_quality:
575:             return whole
576:         return segmented

578:     def _split_words(self, crop: Image.Image) -> List[Image.Image]:
579:         w, h = crop.size
580:         if w < SPLIT_MIN_WIDTH_PX:
581:             return [crop]
582: 
583:         gray = np.array(crop.convert("L"), dtype=np.int32)
584:         hist, _ = np.histogram(gray.flatten(), bins=256, range=(0, 256))
585: 
586:         total = w * h
587:         sum_all = np.sum(np.arange(256) * hist)
588:         sum_b = 0.0
589:         w_b = 0
590:         max_between = -1.0
591:         otsu = 127
592:         for v in range(256):
593:             w_b += hist[v]
594:             if w_b == 0:
595:                 continue
596:             w_f = total - w_b
597:             if w_f == 0:
598:                 break
599:             sum_b += v * hist[v]
600:             m_b = sum_b / w_b
601:             m_f = (sum_all - sum_b) / w_f
602:             between = w_b * w_f * (m_b - m_f) ** 2
603:             if between > max_between:
604:                 max_between = between
605:                 otsu = v
606: 
607:         ink = np.zeros(w, dtype=np.int32)
608:         for y in range(h):
609:             for x in range(w):
610:                 if gray[y, x] < otsu:
611:                     ink[x] += 1
612: 
613:         runs = []
614:         start = -1
615:         for x in range(w):
616:             if ink[x] > 0:
617:                 if start < 0:
618:                     start = x
619:             elif start >= 0:
620:                 runs.append((start, x - 1))
621:                 start = -1
622:         if start >= 0:
623:             runs.append((start, w - 1))
624: 
625:         if len(runs) < 2:
626:             return [crop]
627: 
628:         gaps = [runs[i + 1][0] - runs[i][1] - 1 for i in range(len(runs) - 1)]
629:         positive = sorted([g for g in gaps if g > 0])
630:         median = positive[len(positive) // 2] if positive else 1.0
631:         threshold = max(MIN_WORD_GAP_PX, round(median * WORD_GAP_FACTOR))
632: 
633:         groups = []
634:         group_start = runs[0][0]
635:         split_after = 0
636:         for i, gap in enumerate(gaps):
637:             if gap >= threshold:
638:                 groups.append((group_start, runs[i][1]))
639:                 group_start = runs[i + 1][0]
640:                 split_after += 1
641:         if split_after == 0:
642:             return [crop]
643:         groups.append((group_start, runs[-1][1]))
644: 
645:         if len(groups) <= 1:
646:             return [crop]
647: 
648:         result = []
649:         for g_start, g_end in groups:
650:             # Generous margins: recognizer drops edge glyphs without left
651:             # context (title-bar П lost with -4px).
652:             left = max(0, g_start - 10)
653:             right = min(w, g_end + 8)
654:             result.append(crop.crop((left, 0, max(left + 1, right), h)))
655:         return result

657:     def _is_latin_crop(self, rec: Recognition) -> bool:
658:         # Script routing: clearly Latin evidence -> English engine.
659:         # Digits/punct-only crops (n_lat == n_cyr == 0) stay Cyrillic.
660:         return rec.n_lat >= 2 and rec.n_lat > rec.n_cyr * 1.25

665:                 from rapid_ocr import RapidOCREngine
666:                 eng = RapidOCREngine(lang="en")
667:                 self._rapid = eng if eng.initialize() else False
668:             except Exception as e:
669:                 logger.warning(f"[TfliteOCR] RapidOCR unavailable: {e}")

673:     @staticmethod
674:     def _clean_en_text(text: str) -> str:
675:         # Keep Latin/digits/basic punct/spaces; drop CJK and other scripts
676:         # the EN model hallucinates (e.g. 山白 on icon glyphs).
677:         kept = []
678:         for ch in text:
679:             o = ord(ch)
680:             if ("a" <= ch <= "z" or "A" <= ch <= "Z" or ch.isdigit()
681:                     or ch in " .,!?;:'\"()[]{}-_/\\@#%+*=" or ch in "\n\t"):
682:                 kept.append(ch)
683:             elif ch.isspace():
684:                 kept.append(" ")
685:         return re.sub(r"[ \t]+", " ", "".join(kept)).strip(" \n")

687:     def _recognize_en(self, crop: Image.Image) -> Optional[Recognition]:
688:         """English route via RapidOCR (PP-OCR EN). Returns None when unusable
689:         so the caller falls back to the Cyrillic pipeline."""
690:         from ocr_text_cleaner import latin_fitness
691:         engine = self._rapid_engine()
692:         if engine is None:
693:             return None
694:         try:
695:             # RapidOCR's detector fails on tight word crops (reads CJK junk
696:             # like '二'): retry with a gray margin. Skip the retry when the
697:             # raw read is already confident.
698:             text, conf = engine.recognize(crop)
699:             if conf < 85.0:
700:                 canvas = Image.new("RGB", (crop.width + 24, crop.height + 24),
701:                                    (128, 128, 128))
702:                 canvas.paste(crop, (12, 12))
703:                 try:
704:                     t2, c2 = engine.recognize(canvas)
705:                 except Exception:
706:                     t2, c2 = "", -1.0
707:                 if c2 > conf:
708:                     text, conf = t2, c2
709:         except Exception as e:
710:             logger.warning(f"[TfliteOCR] RapidOCR error: {e}")
711:             return None
712:         clean = self._clean_en_text(text or "")
713:         if not clean or latin_fitness(clean) < 0.5:
714:             return None
715:         return Recognition(text=clean, confidence=max(0.0, min(1.0, conf / 100.0)),
716:                            model="en", coverage=0.0)

718:     def _recognize_crop(self, crop: Image.Image) -> Recognition:
719:         r3 = self._run_recognizer(crop, self._primary, self._primary_chars, "v3")
720:         # English text -> dedicated Latin engine (native word spacing);
721:         # Russian text -> Cyrillic pipeline below.
722:         if self._is_latin_crop(r3):
723:             en = self._recognize_en(crop)
724:             if en is not None and en.text.strip():
725:                 return en
726: 
727:         candidates = [r3]
728: 
729:         if candidates[-1].confidence < CONTRAST_RETRY_CONFIDENCE:
730:             contrast = self._create_high_contrast(crop)
731:             candidates.append(self._run_recognizer(contrast, self._primary, self._primary_chars, "v3"))
732: 
733:         if self._verifier is not None:
734:             v5_result = self._run_recognizer(crop, self._verifier, self._verifier_chars, "v5")
735:             candidates.append(v5_result)
736:             if v5_result.confidence < CONTRAST_RETRY_CONFIDENCE:
737:                 contrast = self._create_high_contrast(crop)
738:                 candidates.append(self._run_recognizer(contrast, self._verifier, self._verifier_chars, "v5"))
739: 
740:         return max(candidates, key=self._candidate_quality) if candidates else Recognition("", 0.0)

742:     def _run_recognizer(self, crop: Image.Image, model, chars: List[str], model_name: str) -> Recognition:
743:         # Long crops would squash horizontally into 320px (glyphs become
744:         # tall/narrow and decode with char errors). Instead cover them with
745:         # overlapping windows that each fit the 320 budget, then merge.
746:         scale = RECOGNIZER_HEIGHT / max(1, crop.height)
747:         scaled_w = crop.width * scale
748:         if scaled_w <= RECOGNIZER_WIDTH:
749:             windows = [crop]
750:         else:
751:             win_w = max(16, int(RECOGNIZER_WIDTH * crop.height / RECOGNIZER_HEIGHT))
752:             stride = max(8, win_w - max(16, win_w // 5))
753:             starts = list(range(0, max(1, crop.width - win_w + 1), stride))
754:             if not starts or starts[-1] + win_w < crop.width:
755:                 starts.append(max(0, crop.width - win_w))
756:             windows = [crop.crop((s, 0, min(crop.width, s + win_w), crop.height))
757:                        for s in starts]
758: 
759:         texts: List[str] = []
760:         conf_sum, conf_count = 0.0, 0
761:         coverage = 0.0
762:         n_lat_total, n_cyr_total = 0, 0
763:         for win in windows:
764:             text, conf, _emitted, cov, n_lat, n_cyr = self._infer_window(
765:                 win, model, chars)
766:             texts.append(text)
767:             conf_sum += conf
768:             conf_count += 1
769:             coverage = max(coverage, cov)
770:             n_lat_total += n_lat
771:             n_cyr_total += n_cyr
772:         merged = self._merge_window_texts(texts)
773:         conf = conf_sum / conf_count if conf_count else 0.0
774:         return Recognition(text=merged, confidence=conf, model=model_name,
775:                            coverage=coverage, n_lat=n_lat_total,
776:                            n_cyr=n_cyr_total)
777: 
778:     # Canonical homoglyph map for overlap comparison only: unifies
779:     # Cyrillic/Ukrainian lookalikes to one base so a 1-char script
780:     # confusion (і/и, о/o, е/e) between windows does not break merging.
781:     _MERGE_CANON = {
782:         'а': 'a', 'с': 'c', 'е': 'e', 'о': 'o', 'р': 'p', 'х': 'x', 'у': 'y',
783:         'А': 'a', 'В': 'b', 'С': 'c', 'Е': 'e', 'Н': 'h', 'К': 'k', 'М': 'm',
784:         'О': 'o', 'Р': 'p', 'Т': 't', 'Х': 'x', 'У': 'y',
785:         'і': 'i', 'І': 'i', 'ї': 'i', 'є': 'e', 'Є': 'e', 'ґ': 'g', 'Ґ': 'g',
786:         'ё': 'е', 'Ё': 'е',
787:     }
788: 
789:     @classmethod
790:     def _canon(cls, s: str) -> str:
791:         return "".join(cls._MERGE_CANON.get(c, c).lower() for c in s)
792: 
793:     @classmethod
794:     def _merge_window_texts(cls, texts: List[str]) -> str:
795:         # Overlapping windows share content: append only the non-overlapping
796:         # tail. Window cuts can drop edge glyphs, so the shared content is
797:         # found as a longest common SUBSTRING between the merged tail and
798:         # the next window head (not just affix), compared in canonical
799:         # homoglyph form; splicing keeps the original strings.
800:         merged = texts[0] if texts else ""
801:         for nxt in texts[1:]:
802:             if not nxt:
803:                 continue
804:             if not merged:
805:                 merged = nxt
806:                 continue
807:             tail = cls._canon(merged[-48:])
808:             head = cls._canon(nxt[:48])
809:             best_k, best_L = 0, 0
810:             for k in range(0, min(24, len(nxt))):
811:                 maxL = min(len(nxt) - k, len(tail))
812:                 for L in range(maxL, 3, -1):
813:                     if L > best_L and head[k:k + L] in tail:
814:                         best_k, best_L = k, L
815:                         break
816:                 if best_L >= 8:
817:                     break
818:             merged += nxt[best_k + best_L:]
819:         return merged

821:     def _infer_window(self, crop: Image.Image, model, chars: List[str]):
822:         rec_img = Image.new("RGB", (RECOGNIZER_WIDTH, RECOGNIZER_HEIGHT), (128, 128, 128))
823:         scale = RECOGNIZER_HEIGHT / max(1, crop.height)
824:         target_w = min(RECOGNIZER_WIDTH, max(1, int(crop.width * scale)))
825:         resized = crop.resize((target_w, RECOGNIZER_HEIGHT), Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)
826:         rec_img.paste(resized, (0, 0))
827: 
828:         arr = np.array(rec_img, dtype=np.float32)
829:         arr = arr[:, :, ::-1]  # RGB -> BGR
830:         arr = (arr / 255.0 - 0.5) / 0.5
831: 
832:         inp = model.get_input_details()
833:         out = model.get_output_details()
834:         model.set_tensor(inp[0]['index'], arr.reshape(1, RECOGNIZER_HEIGHT, RECOGNIZER_WIDTH, 3))
835:         model.invoke()
836:         values = model.get_tensor(out[0]['index'])
837: 
838:         # Output shape: (1, steps, num_classes) - raw logits (see CtcScoring.softmax).
839:         # Classes come from actual output size, not dict length (165 vs 163+1).
840:         if values.ndim == 3:
841:             seq = values[0]  # (steps, num_classes)
842:             _steps, num_classes = seq.shape
843:             return self._decode_ctc(seq.reshape(-1), chars, int(num_classes))
844:         return ("", 0.0, 0, 0.0, 0, 0)
845: 
846:     def _decode_ctc(self, values: np.ndarray, chars: List[str], num_classes: int):
847:         if num_classes <= 1 or len(values) < num_classes:
848:             return ("", 0.0, 0, 0.0, 0, 0)
849: 
850:         # Per-class script flags for EN/RU routing (digits/punct neutral).
851:         is_lat = [False] * num_classes
852:         is_cyr = [False] * num_classes
853:         for idx in range(1, num_classes):
854:             if idx - 1 >= len(chars):
855:                 continue
856:             ch = chars[idx - 1]
857:             if len(ch) == 1:
858:                 if "a" <= ch <= "z" or "A" <= ch <= "Z":
859:                     is_lat[idx] = True
860:                 elif 0x0400 <= ord(ch) <= 0x052F or 0xA640 <= ord(ch) <= 0xA69F:
861:                     is_cyr[idx] = True
862: 
863:         steps = len(values) // num_classes
864:         text_parts = []
865:         prev = -1
866:         conf_sum = 0.0
867:         conf_count = 0
868:         blank_steps = 0
869:         counting_blanks = False
870:         n_lat = 0
871:         n_cyr = 0
872: 
873:         for step in range(steps):
874:             base = step * num_classes
875:             logits = values[base:base + num_classes]
876:             max_logit = np.max(logits)
877:             exp_logits = np.exp(logits - max_logit)
878:             probs = exp_logits / np.sum(exp_logits)
879: 
880:             best_idx = 0
881:             best_score = probs[0]
882:             best_lat = 0.0
883:             best_cyr = 0.0
884:             for idx in range(1, num_classes):
885:                 # Match Kotlin: chars.getOrNull(idx-1).orEmpty() + allowed('')
886:                 # Out-of-range classes (164/165, 851/852) are skipped.
887:                 char = chars[idx - 1] if idx - 1 < len(chars) else ''
888:                 if not self._allowed(char):
889:                     continue
890:                 if probs[idx] > best_score:
891:                     best_score = probs[idx]
892:                     best_idx = idx
893:                 if is_lat[idx] and probs[idx] > best_lat:
894:                     best_lat = probs[idx]
895:                 elif is_cyr[idx] and probs[idx] > best_cyr:
896:                     best_cyr = probs[idx]
897: 
898:             # Script evidence: winning side needs a clear margin AND to beat
899:             # uniform noise, so padding steps (blank/uniform) don't vote.
900:             if best_lat > 0.008 and best_lat > best_cyr * 1.2:
901:                 n_lat += 1
902:             elif best_cyr > 0.008 and best_cyr > best_lat * 1.2:
903:                 n_cyr += 1
904: 
905:             if best_idx != 0 and best_idx != prev:
906:                 if best_idx - 1 < len(chars):
907:                     text_parts.append(chars[best_idx - 1])
908:                 conf_sum += best_score
909:                 conf_count += 1
910:                 counting_blanks = True
911:             elif best_idx == 0 and counting_blanks:
912:                 blank_steps += 1
913: 
914:             prev = best_idx
915: 
916:         text = "".join(text_parts).strip()
917:         conf = conf_sum / conf_count if conf_count > 0 else 0.0
918:         inner_blank_cov = 0.0
919:         if conf_count > 0 and steps > 0:
920:             inner = steps - conf_count
921:             if inner > 0:
922:                 inner_blank_cov = min(1.0, blank_steps) * (inner / steps)
923:         return (text, conf, conf_count, inner_blank_cov, n_lat, n_cyr)
924: 
925:     def _allowed(self, char: str) -> bool:
926:         # Decode alphabet = dict coverage: Cyrillic + Latin + digits +
927:         # whitespace + punctuation. Script normalization happens later,
928:         # per word, in fix_lookalikes_per_word (Latin lookalikes -> Cyrillic
929:         # inside Cyrillic words, pure Latin kept as-is). Blocking Latin here
930:         # forces true-Latin steps into blank/Cyrillic crumbs and breaks
931:         # neighboring words (e.g. window title "... yomihon-custom ...").
932:         if len(char) != 1:
933:             return False
934:         cp = ord(char)
935:         if 0x0400 <= cp <= 0x052F or 0xA640 <= cp <= 0xA69F:
936:             return True
937:         if char.isspace() or char in ALLOWED_PUNCTUATION:
938:             return True
939:         if 'a' <= char <= 'z' or 'A' <= char <= 'Z' or '0' <= char <= '9':
940:             return True
941:         return False

943:     def _candidate_quality(self, rec: Recognition) -> float:
944:         if not rec.text.strip():
945:             return float('-inf')
946:         from ocr_text_cleaner import cyrillic_fitness, latin_fitness, is_acceptable_cyrillic_text, fix_lookalikes_per_word
947:         if rec.model == "en":
948:             fitness = latin_fitness(rec.text)
949:         else:
950:             fitness = cyrillic_fitness(rec.text)
