"""
Модуль переводчика.

Поддерживаемые сервисы:
  1. Zen (opencode.ai) — бесплатные модели, БЕЗ ключа
  2. Google Translate (unofficial) — бесплатный fallback
  3. DeepL Free (unofficial) — бесплатный fallback

Приоритет: Zen -> Google Translate -> DeepL -> Offline

УДАЛЁННЫЕ провайдеры (проверено 26.09.2026, не работали):
  * OrcaRouter — api.orcarouter.ai/v1/chat/completions отдаёт 404,
    эндпоинт больше не существует;
  * OpenRouter — ключ из настроек отклоняется с 403 Forbidden.

По Zen важно: почти все её free-модели отдают
  403 FreeTierError: "OpenCode's free tier can only be used from within
  OpenCode" — снаружи OpenCode они недоступны. Работает space-bunny-free,
  именно он стоит первым в ZEN_MODELS.
"""
import logging
import json
import re
import threading
import time
import requests

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

# ─── Языки ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
LANGUAGES = {
    "auto": "Auto-detect",
    "en": "English",
    "ru": "Russian",
    "ja": "Japanese",
    "ko": "Korean",
    "zh": "Chinese",
    "de": "German",
    "fr": "French",
    "es": "Spanish",
    "it": "Italian",
    "pt": "Portuguese",
    "ar": "Arabic",
    "hi": "Hindi",
    "tr": "Turkish",
    "pl": "Polish",
    "nl": "Dutch",
    "sv": "Swedish",
    "fi": "Finnish",
    "uk": "Ukrainian",
    "cs": "Czech",
    "el": "Greek",
    "he": "Hebrew",
    "th": "Thai",
    "vi": "Vietnamese",
    "id": "Indonesian",
    "ms": "Malay",
}

# ── Устойчивость к троттлингу Google Translate ────────────────────────────
# Бесплатный endpoint translate_a/single отдаёт 429 «Sorry...» при частых
# запросах с одного IP. В игре реплики идут каждые несколько секунд, поэтому:
#   * одна Session с keep-alive (меньше рукопожатий);
#   * минимальный интервал между запросами;
#   * повтор с нарастающей паузой;
#   * кэш переводов (игровые реплики повторяются).
_GOOGLE_URL = "https://translate.googleapis.com/translate_a/single"
_GOOGLE_MIN_INTERVAL = 1.1     # секунд между запросами к Google
_GOOGLE_RETRY_DELAYS = (1.5, 4.0)
_google_last_call = 0.0
_google_lock = threading.Lock()
_session = None


def _get_session():
    global _session
    if _session is None:
        _session = requests.Session()
        _session.headers.update({
            "User-Agent": ("Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) "
                           "AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) "
                           "Chrome/120.0 Safari/537.36"),
            "Accept": "*/*",
        })
    return _session


def _google_get(params, timeout):
    """GET к Google с троттлингом и повторами при 429. Возвращает Response
    или None, если все попытки исчерпаны."""
    global _google_last_call
    delay = 0
    for attempt in range(len(_GOOGLE_RETRY_DELAYS) + 1):
        if attempt:
            delay = _GOOGLE_RETRY_DELAYS[attempt - 1]
            time.sleep(delay)
        with _google_lock:
            wait = _GOOGLE_MIN_INTERVAL - (time.monotonic() - _google_last_call)
            if wait > 0:
                time.sleep(wait)
            _google_last_call = time.monotonic()
        try:
            resp = _get_session().get(_GOOGLE_URL, params=params, timeout=timeout)
        except Exception as e:
            logger.debug(f"Google request failed: {e}")
            continue
        if resp.status_code == 200:
            return resp
        if resp.status_code in (429, 503):
            logger.debug(f"Google throttled ({resp.status_code}), "
                         f"повтор через {delay or _GOOGLE_MIN_INTERVAL:.1f}c")
            continue
        logger.debug(f"Google HTTP {resp.status_code}")
        return None
    return None


# Названия языков для промпта LLM
_LANG_NAMES = {
    "auto": "the appropriate language",    "en": "English", "ru": "Russian", "ja": "Japanese",
    "ko": "Korean", "zh": "Chinese", "de": "German",
    "fr": "French", "es": "Spanish", "it": "Italian",
    "pt": "Portuguese", "ar": "Arabic", "hi": "Hindi",
    "tr": "Turkish", "pl": "Polish", "nl": "Dutch",
    "sv": "Swedish", "fi": "Finnish", "uk": "Ukrainian",
    "cs": "Czech", "el": "Greek", "he": "Hebrew",
    "th": "Thai", "vi": "Vietnamese", "id": "Indonesian",
    "ms": "Malay",
}

_TIMEOUT = 30

# Модели Zen (opencode.ai), доступные БЕЗ ключа из внешнего приложения.
# Проверено 26.09.2026 прямыми запросами к /zen/v1/chat/completions:
#   space-bunny-free                        -> HTTP 200, точный русский
#   mimo-v2.6-flash-free                    -> 403 FreeTierError
#   mimo-v2.5-free                          -> 403 FreeTierError
#   nemotron-3.5-lightning-free             -> 403 FreeTierError
#   deepseek-v4-flash-free                  -> 400 Model is unavailable
#   jev-1.13-free / muse-spark-*-free / ... -> 401/403/500
# 403 FreeTierError = «can only be used from within OpenCode», то есть
# из нашего скрипта эти модели недоступны.
ZEN_MODELS = ["space-bunny-free"]

# Перевод, который выглядит как НЕПЕРЕВЕДЁННЫЙ источник. Раньше такой мусор
# молча уходил в TTS: «Adventure time!» -> «Adventure время»,
# «Off we go!» -> «выкл we идти». Ловим по строчным латинским словам
# внутри русского текста (имена вроде Genshin/Paimon начинаются с заглавной
# и допускаются).
_LATIN_WORD = re.compile(r"(?<![A-Za-z])([a-z]{2,})(?![A-Za-z])")


def looks_untranslated(text: str, dst: str = "ru") -> bool:
    """True, если перевод suspicious: русский текст с нетронутыми словами."""
    if not text or dst not in ("ru", "uk", "be", "bg"):
        return False
    return bool(_LATIN_WORD.search(text))


class Translator:
    """Переводчик с приоритетом Zen -> Google Translate -> DeepL -> Offline.

    Провайдеры OrcaRouter и OpenRouter удалены 26.09.2026: их endpoints
    не отвечают (404 / 403). Параметры orcarouter_*/openrouter_* в configure()
    оставлены для совместимости старых вызовов и игнорируются.
    """

    def __init__(self, source="auto", target="en", **kwargs):
        self._api_key: str = ""
        self._model: str = ""
        self._source = source
        self._target = target
        self._zen_model: str = ""
        # Офлайн-словарь — только для OCR. Для озвучки его выключают:
        # пословный перевод звучит хуже, чем молчание.
        self.allow_offline_dict: bool = True
        # Кэш переводов: в игре реплики часто повторяются, а каждый запрос
        # к внешнему сервису — это риск попасть под троттлинг.
        self._cache: dict = {}
        self._cache_max = 500

    def configure(self, api_key: str = "", model: str = "",
                  orcarouter_key: str = "", orcarouter_model: str = "",
                  openrouter_key: str = "", openrouter_model: str = "",
                  zen_model: str = ""):
        """Устанавливает ключи и модели сервисов.

        orcarouter_* / openrouter_* оставлены как no-op: провайдеры удалены,
        но старые вызовы из GUI не должны падать с TypeError.
        """
        self._api_key = (api_key or "").strip()
        self._model = (model or "").strip()
        # У Zen своя модель: раньше сюда попадала общая translation.model
        # (например qwen/...), и Zen отдавал пословную кашу.
        self._zen_model = (zen_model or "").strip()

    def _zen_candidates(self, fallback: str = "") -> list:
        """Список моделей Zen для перебора: настроенная, затем рабочие.

        Модель из настроек идёт первой, но если она из тех, что отдают
        403 FreeTierError, перебор падает на проверенную space-bunny-free.
        Идентификаторы Zen никогда не содержат «/», поэтому модели в формате
        openrouter/orcarouter (например «qwen/qwen3.8-27b-free») отбрасываются
        без сетевого запроса — они всё равно вернули бы 401/404.
        """
        out = []
        for m in (self._zen_model, (fallback or "").strip(), *ZEN_MODELS):
            m = (m or "").strip()
            if m and "/" in m:
                continue
            if m and m not in out:
                out.append(m)
        return out or list(ZEN_MODELS)

    def translate(self, text: str, src: str = None, dst: str = None,
                  api_key: str = "", model: str = "",
                  engine: str = "auto") -> str:
        """
        Переводит текст. Пробует сервисы по порядку.
        engine: "auto", "zen", "google", "deepl"

        Провайдеры OrcaRouter и OpenRouter удалены: их endpoints не отвечают
        (404 / 403). Старые вызовы engine="orcarouter"/"openrouter" вернут
        понятное сообщение вместо обращения к мёртвым адресам.
        """
        if not text or not text.strip():
            return ""

        src = src or self._source or "auto"
        dst = dst or self._target or "en"

        key = api_key or self._api_key
        mdl = model or self._model

        # Кэш: точный повтор перевода отдаём сразу, без обращения к сети
        ckey = (src, dst, text.strip())
        if ckey in self._cache:
            return self._cache[ckey]

        if engine in ("orcarouter", "openrouter"):
            logger.warning(f"[Translator] Провайдер {engine} удалён "
                           f"(endpoint не отвечает). Используйте Zen.")
            return f"[{engine} removed: endpoint unavailable]"

        if engine == "zen":
            # Раньше здесь бралась одна mdl = model or self._model, а GUI
            # передаёт модель только в zen_model. Тогда mdl была пустой,
            # _translate_zen подставлял свой старый default
            # (mimo-v2.5-free) и получал 403 FreeTierError.
            # Теперь идём по кандидатам: явный выбор -> zen_model -> default.
            last = ""
            for zen_model in self._zen_candidates(mdl):
                try:
                    result = self._translate_zen(text, src, dst, zen_model)
                    got = self._accept(result, ckey, f"Zen/{zen_model}")
                    if got:
                        return got
                    last = result
                except Exception as e:
                    logger.debug(f"Zen/{zen_model} failed: {e}")
                    last = f"Zen/{zen_model}: {e}"
            return f"[Zen failed: {last}]"

        # Auto mode — пробуем по порядку.
        # OrcaRouter (404) и OpenRouter (403) удалены как мёртвые.
        #
        # 1. Zen (opencode.ai) — бесплатные модели БЕЗ ключа.
        #    Проверено 26.09.2026: space-bunny-free отдаёт точный русский
        #    за 1.6-2.2 c («Adventure time!» -> «Время приключений!»).
        #    Остальные free-модели Zen отдают 403 FreeTierError
        #    («can only be used from within OpenCode»), поэтому запасная
        #    модель в ZEN_MODELS.
        for zen_model in self._zen_candidates(mdl):
            try:
                result = self._translate_zen(text, src, dst, zen_model)
                got = self._accept(result, ckey, f"Zen/{zen_model}")
                if got:
                    return got
            except Exception as e:
                logger.debug(f"Zen/{zen_model} failed: {e}")

        # 2. Google Translate — специализированный MT, даёт нормальный русский
        #    без ключа, но часто отдаёт 429 (троттлинг IP), поэтому идёт вторым.
        try:
            result = self._translate_google(text, src, dst)
            got = self._accept(result, ckey, "Google")
            if got:
                return got
        except Exception as e:
            logger.debug(f"Google Translate failed: {e}")

        # 3. DeepL free API (no key needed for small texts)
        try:
            result = self._translate_deepl_free(text, src, dst)
            got = self._accept(result, ckey, "DeepL")
            if got:
                return got
        except Exception as e:
            logger.debug(f"DeepL free failed: {e}")

        # 4. Offline dictionary fallback (EN→RU only).
        #    ВНИМАНИЕ: словарь переводит ПОСЛОВНО и даёт мусор
        #    («Are you bringing the map?» -> «являются Ю ПРИВЕДЕНИЕ карта»).
        #    Для озвучки его использовать нельзя, поэтому голосовой путь
        #    выключает его флагом allow_offline_dict и получает честный отказ.
        if self.allow_offline_dict and dst == "ru" and (src in ("en", "auto")):
            try:
                from en_ru_dict import translate_text
                result = translate_text(text)
                if result:
                    logger.info("[Translator] Used offline dictionary fallback")
                    return self._cache_put(ckey, result)
            except Exception as e:
                logger.debug(f"Offline dict failed: {e}")

        return "[Translation failed: all services unavailable]"

    def _cache_put(self, key, value: str) -> str:
        """Положить перевод в кэш (с ограничением размера)."""
        if len(self._cache) >= self._cache_max:
            # выбросим половину (FIFO-подобное усечение)
            for k in list(self._cache)[:self._cache_max // 2]:
                self._cache.pop(k, None)
        self._cache[key] = value
        return value

    def _accept(self, result: str, ckey, engine_name: str) -> str:
        """Пропустить результат через проверку «похоже на перевод»."""
        if not result:
            return ""
        if result.startswith("[") and result.endswith("]"):
            return ""            # это маркер отказа, а не перевод
        if looks_untranslated(result, ckey[1]):
            logger.warning(f"[Translator] {engine_name} вернул непереведённый "
                           f"текст, отбрасываем: {result[:60]!r}")
            return ""
        return self._cache_put(ckey, result)

    # ── Zen (opencode.ai, free) ────────────────────────────────────────

    def _translate_zen(self, text: str, src: str, dst: str, model: str) -> str:
        """Перевод через Zen API (бесплатный, без ключа)."""
        dst_name = _LANG_NAMES.get(dst, dst)

        if src == "auto":
            prompt = (
                f"Translate the following text to {dst_name}. "
                f"Output ONLY the translated text, nothing else.\n\n{text}"
            )
        else:
            src_name = _LANG_NAMES.get(src, src)
            prompt = (
                f"Translate the following text from {src_name} to {dst_name}. "
                f"Output ONLY the translated text, nothing else.\n\n{text}"
            )

        resp = requests.post(
            "https://opencode.ai/zen/v1/chat/completions",
            headers={
                "Content-Type": "application/json",
                "HTTP-Referer": "https://github.com/sj0404-collab/overlay-translator",
                "X-Title": "ScreenOCR_TTS",
            },
            json={
                "model": model or "mimo-v2.5-free",
                "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": prompt}],
                "temperature": 0.1,
                "max_tokens": 4096,
            },
            timeout=_TIMEOUT,
        )
        resp.raise_for_status()
        data = resp.json()

        content = data.get("choices", [{}])[0].get("message", {}).get("content", "")
        if content and content.strip():
            return content.strip()
        return ""

    # ── Google Translate (fallback) ────────────────────────────────────

    def _translate_google(self, text: str, src: str, dst: str) -> str:
        """Google Translate — бесплатный unofficial API (через gtx-клиент)."""
        params = {
            "client": "gtx",
            "sl": src,
            "tl": dst,
            "dt": "t",
            "q": text,
        }
        resp = _google_get(params, _TIMEOUT)
        if resp is None:
            return ""
        try:
            data = resp.json()
        except Exception as e:
            logger.debug(f"Google bad payload: {e}")
            return ""

        if data and data[0]:
            result = "".join(part[0] for part in data[0] if part[0])
            detected = data[2] if len(data) > 2 else None

            if result and result.strip() != text.strip():
                return result.strip()

            if detected == dst:
                return text.strip()

        return ""

    # ── DeepL Free (unofficial) ──────────────────────────────────────────

    def _translate_deepl_free(self, text: str, src: str, dst: str) -> str:
        """DeepL free via unofficial endpoint (no API key needed)."""
        # DeepL language codes
        dl_map = {
            "en": "EN", "ru": "RU", "de": "DE", "fr": "FR", "es": "ES",
            "it": "IT", "pt": "PT", "ja": "JA", "zh": "ZH", "ko": "KO",
            "nl": "NL", "pl": "PL", "uk": "UK", "tr": "TR",
        }
        sl = dl_map.get(src, "EN") if src != "auto" else "EN"
        tl = dl_map.get(dst, "RU")

        resp = requests.post(
            "https://www2.deepl.com/jsonrpc",
            json={
                "jsonrpc": "2.0",
                "method": "LMT_handle_texts",
                "params": {
                    "texts": [{"text": text, "requestAlternatives": 0}],
                    "splitting": "newlines",
                    "lang": {"source_lang_user_selected": sl, "target_lang": tl},
                    "commonJobParams": {"wasSpoken": False, "transcribe_as": ""},
                },
            },
            headers={
                "User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0",
                "Content-Type": "application/json",
            },
            timeout=_TIMEOUT,
        )
        resp.raise_for_status()
        data = resp.json()

        if "result" in data:
            texts = data["result"].get("texts", [])
            if texts:
                translated = texts[0].get("text", "")
                if translated and translated.strip() != text.strip():
                    return translated.strip()
        return ""

    # ── Проверка соединения ────────────────────────────────────────────

    def test_connection(self, api_key: str = "", model: str = "",
                        engine: str = "zen") -> dict:
        """
        Тестирует подключение к указанному сервису.
        engine: "zen" (по умолчанию), "google", "deepl"
        Возвращает dict с полями:
            ok: bool — успешно ли
            message: str — описание результата
            tokens_prompt: int — токены промпта
            tokens_completion: int — токены ответа
            tokens_total: int — всего токенов
            latency_ms: int — задержка в мс
        """
        import time
        result = {
            "ok": False, "message": "", "tokens_prompt": 0,
            "tokens_completion": 0, "tokens_total": 0, "latency_ms": 0,
        }

        if engine in ("orcarouter", "openrouter"):
            result["message"] = (
                f"Провайдер {engine} удалён: endpoint не отвечает "
                f"(404/403). Используйте Zen (бесплатно, без ключа)."
            )
            return result

        # Zen — единственный LLM-провайдер: free, без ключа.
        key = ""
        mdl = model or (self._zen_model or ZEN_MODELS[0])
        endpoint = "https://opencode.ai/zen/v1/chat/completions"

        t0 = time.monotonic()
        try:
            headers = {
                "Content-Type": "application/json",
            }
            if key:
                headers["Authorization"] = f"Bearer {key.strip()}"
            if engine == "zen":
                headers["HTTP-Referer"] = "https://github.com/sj0404-collab/overlay-translator"
                headers["X-Title"] = "ScreenOCR_TTS"

            resp = requests.post(
                endpoint,
                headers=headers,
                json={
                    "model": mdl,
                    "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "Say OK"}],
                    "max_tokens": 10,
                },
                timeout=15,
            )
            latency = int((time.monotonic() - t0) * 1000)
            result["latency_ms"] = latency

            if resp.status_code == 200:
                data = resp.json()
                usage = data.get("usage", {})
                result["ok"] = True
                result["message"] = f"Connected OK ({mdl})"
                result["tokens_prompt"] = usage.get("prompt_tokens", 0)
                result["tokens_completion"] = usage.get("completion_tokens", 0)
                result["tokens_total"] = usage.get("total_tokens", 0)
            else:
                err = resp.json().get("error", {})
                msg = err.get("message", resp.text[:200])
                result["message"] = f"HTTP {resp.status_code}: {msg}"
        except requests.exceptions.Timeout:
            result["message"] = "Timeout (15s)"
        except requests.exceptions.ConnectionError as e:
            result["message"] = f"Connection error: {e}"
        except Exception as e:
            result["message"] = f"Error: {e}"

        return result

package com.screenocr.tts.settings

import android.content.Context
import android.content.SharedPreferences
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.StateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.asStateFlow

/**
 * Порт settings.py. Хранилище — SharedPreferences, но структура ключей
 * повторяет config.json из десктопной версии, чтобы конфиг переносился.
 */
class Settings private constructor(context: Context) {

    private val prefs: SharedPreferences =
        context.getSharedPreferences("screen_ocr_tts", Context.MODE_PRIVATE)

    private val _changes = MutableStateFlow(0L)
    val changes: StateFlow<Long> = _changes.asStateFlow()

    fun get(key: String, default: String): String =
        prefs.getString(key, default) ?: default

    fun get(key: String, default: Int): Int =
        prefs.getInt(key, default)

    fun get(key: String, default: Boolean): Boolean =
        prefs.getBoolean(key, default)

    fun get(key: String, default: Float): Float =
        prefs.getFloat(key, default)

    fun set(key: String, value: String) = put(key, value)
    fun set(key: String, value: Int) = put(key, value)
    fun set(key: String, value: Boolean) = put(key, value)
    fun set(key: String, value: Float) = put(key, value)

    private fun put(key: String, value: Any) {
        val editor = prefs.edit()
        when (value) {
            is String -> editor.putString(key, value)
            is Int -> editor.putInt(key, value)
            is Boolean -> editor.putBoolean(key, value)
            is Float -> editor.putFloat(key, value)
            else -> editor.putString(key, value.toString())
        }
        editor.apply()
        _changes.value = _changes.value + 1
    }

    fun all(): Map<String, *> = prefs.all

    fun clear() {
        prefs.edit().clear().apply()
        _changes.value = _changes.value + 1
    }

    // ── Схема ключей (зеркалит config.example.json) ─────────────

    object Ocr {
        const val ENGINE = "ocr.engine"
        const val LANGUAGE = "ocr.language"
        const val CONFIDENCE = "ocr.confidence_threshold"
        const val SCAN_INTERVAL_MS = "ocr.scan_interval_ms"
        const val AUTO_TRANSLATE = "ocr.auto_translate"
        const val DETECT_CHANGES = "ocr.detect_changes"
        const val CHANGE_THRESHOLD = "ocr.change_threshold"
        const val MULTI_PASS = "ocr.multi_pass"
        const val USE_GPU = "ocr.use_gpu"
        const val DET_LIMIT_SIDE = "ocr.det_limit_side"
    }

    object Tts {
        const val ENGINE = "tts.engine"
        const val VOICE = "tts.voice"
        const val RATE = "tts.rate"
        const val PITCH = "tts.pitch"
        const val VOLUME = "tts.volume"
        const val CACHE = "tts.cache_audio"
        const val MALE_VOICE = "tts.male_voice"
        const val FEMALE_VOICE = "tts.female_voice"
        const val NARRATOR_VOICE = "tts.narrator_voice"
        const val MALE_RATE = "tts.male_rate"
        const val MALE_PITCH = "tts.male_pitch"
        const val FEMALE_RATE = "tts.female_rate"
        const val FEMALE_PITCH = "tts.female_pitch"
        const val NARRATOR_RATE = "tts.narrator_rate"
        const val NARRATOR_PITCH = "tts.narrator_pitch"
        const val DUAL_VOICE = "tts.dual_voice_enabled"
    }

    object Translate {
        const val ENABLED = "translation.enabled"
        const val ENGINE = "translation.engine"
        const val DST_LANG = "translation.dst_lang"
        const val SRC_LANG = "translation.src_lang"
        const val ZEN_MODEL = "translation.zen_model"
        const val ZEN_KEY = "translation.zen_key"
        const val DEEPL_KEY = "translation.deepl_key"
    }

    object Overlay {
        const val ENABLED = "overlay.enabled"
        const val SHOW_TEXT = "overlay.show_text"
        const val OPACITY = "overlay.opacity"
        const val FONT_SIZE = "overlay.font_size"
        const val PANEL_OPACITY = "overlay.panel_opacity"
    }

    object Stt {
        const val ENABLED = "stt.enabled"
        const val CHUNK_MS = "stt.chunk_ms"
        const val SILENCE_MS = "stt.silence_ms"
        const val ECHO_GRACE_MS = "stt.echo_grace_ms"
    }

    object General {
        const val LOG_LEVEL = "general.log_level"
        const val START_MINIMIZED = "general.start_minimized"
    }

    /** Значения по умолчанию — как в config.example.json. */
    fun applyDefaults() {
        val d: List<Pair<String, Any>> = listOf(
            Ocr.ENGINE to "tflite_cyrillic",
            Ocr.LANGUAGE to "rus+eng",
            Ocr.CONFIDENCE to 40,
            Ocr.SCAN_INTERVAL_MS to 700,
            Ocr.AUTO_TRANSLATE to true,
            Ocr.DETECT_CHANGES to true,
            Ocr.CHANGE_THRESHOLD to 0.05f,
            Ocr.MULTI_PASS to false,
            Ocr.USE_GPU to false,
            Ocr.DET_LIMIT_SIDE to 736,
            Tts.ENGINE to "edge",
            Tts.VOICE to "ru-RU-DmitryNeural",
            Tts.RATE to 15,
            Tts.PITCH to 0,
            Tts.VOLUME to 1.0f,
            Tts.CACHE to true,
            Tts.MALE_VOICE to "ru-RU-DmitryNeural",
            Tts.FEMALE_VOICE to "ru-RU-SvetlanaNeural",
            Tts.NARRATOR_VOICE to "ru-RU-DmitryNeural",
            Tts.MALE_RATE to 15,
            Tts.MALE_PITCH to 0,
            Tts.FEMALE_RATE to 15,
            Tts.FEMALE_PITCH to 0,
            Tts.NARRATOR_RATE to 15,
            Tts.NARRATOR_PITCH to 0,
            Tts.DUAL_VOICE to false,
            Translate.ENABLED to true,
            Translate.ENGINE to "offline",
            Translate.DST_LANG to "ru",
            Translate.SRC_LANG to "auto",
            Translate.ZEN_MODEL to "space-bunny-free",
            Overlay.ENABLED to true,
            Overlay.SHOW_TEXT to true,
            Overlay.OPACITY to 0.85f,
            Overlay.FONT_SIZE to 14,
            Overlay.PANEL_OPACITY to 0.9f,
            Stt.ENABLED to false,
            Stt.CHUNK_MS to 2000,
            Stt.SILENCE_MS to 600,
            Stt.ECHO_GRACE_MS to 700,
            General.LOG_LEVEL to "INFO",
            General.START_MINIMIZED to false,
        )
        val editor = prefs.edit()
        for ((key, value) in d) {
            val present = prefs.contains(key)
            if (!present) {
                when (value) {
                    is String -> editor.putString(key, value)
                    is Int -> editor.putInt(key, value)
                    is Boolean -> editor.putBoolean(key, value)
                    is Float -> editor.putFloat(key, value)
                }
            }
        }
        editor.apply()
    }

    companion object {
        @Volatile
        private var instance: Settings? = null

        fun get(context: Context): Settings =
            instance ?: synchronized(this) {
                instance ?: Settings(context.applicationContext).also {
                    it.applyDefaults()
                    instance = it
                }
            }
    }
}

Interesting: the user said "~184 multi-word phrases out of 1447" but the actual asset has 6132 multiword keys out of 68155. Whatever — the design should be a compiled single alternation regex. With 6132 phrases, a single alternation regex sorted longest-first is still viable (Java regex compiles alternations into a sequence of tries — java.util.regex.Pattern with 6132 alternatives could be a large pattern but manageable, maybe 100-200KB of pattern text). Actually Java's Pattern handles large alternations OK but compile time might be ~100ms once. Alternative: a trie-based single-pass matcher, which is more robust and faster. Let me think.

Better approach: build a trie (nested map or sorted-array based trie) of the multi-word phrase keys, and do a greedy longest-match scan over the tokenized text. That is genuinely O(n) and avoids giant regex compile. The task says "либо используй single-pass поиск" (or use a single-pass search) — so a trie single-pass is explicitly allowed and is the best engineering choice.

But note: the Python logic is character-level replacement of phrases in the raw (lowercased, contraction-expanded) string with placeholders, then whitespace splitting, then word lookup. Note the Python `translate` uses `\b`+escaped phrase+`\b` regex search, sorted by length descending, and replaces with placeholders `__PH0__` etc. This means phrase matching happens on the string level, and word-boundary matching. Then splits by whitespace, strips non-word chars to get `pure`, checks placeholder, articles, words dict.

Note a subtlety: in Python, the phrase replacement happens over the whole text so phrases can span multiple whitespace-separated tokens. Then each token is checked: `pure = re.sub(r'[^\w]','',w)`; `pure in pm` → placeholder. Note placeholders `__PH0__` — `\w` includes underscore, digits, letters, so `__PH0__` survives the `[^\w]` strip. Good.

I'll port this faithfully but efficiently:
1. lowercase + trim
2. contractions expansion — Python does naive `t.replace(s, f)` for each contraction in dict order. That naive replace is a source of bugs (e.g. "it's" → "it is" fine; but "he's" inside "she's" → "she" + "he is"?? Let's check: iterate dict; "he's" appears in "she's" → replacing "he's" with "he is" gives "she is". Hmm that's actually semantically same-ish for "she's" = "she is". Interesting. Also "i'm" inside nothing. Also "let's" → "let us". Also note "it's" — dictionary order matters: "he's" comes before "it's", "she's". In Python dict order: "let's","don't","doesn't","didn't","won't","can't","couldn't","wouldn't","shouldn't","isn't","aren't","wasn't","weren't","haven't","hasn't","hadn't","i'm","you're","he's","she's","it's",...

For a faithful but better port: use a single precompiled regex with word boundaries, replacing all at once. The instruction says "Порт логики: lowercase → раскрытие сокращений (contractions) → поиск многословных фраз". I'll implement a token-level approach: a combined alternation regex sorted by length desc, with `\b` boundaries, replaced via a Matcher loop — semantically the same set of expansions and single pass (like the offline dict phrase handling). Actually to be careful about fidelity: naive sequential replace can produce different results in odd cases, e.g. "i'll" → after "i'm"? no. Consider "you're" and "'re": no. Consider "we'd": after "i'd" replaced? "i'd" occurs in "we'd"? No — "we'd" contains "e'd", not "i'd". Consider "he's" inside "she's" → both give same result. Consider "it's" inside... "it's" — no other contains it. So the combined alternation approach yields identical results in practice. But to be safe and deterministic, I'll sort alternatives longest-first and do a single-pass Matcher replacement, with an option. Hmm, but the naive sequential behavior: after replacing "let's" → "let us", later "let's" won't be re-matched. One-pass gives the same.

One difference: naive `str.replace` replaces inside larger words (no word boundary). E.g. "they're" — no issue. But: "isn't" replacement... Consider "he'd" inside "she'd" → "she would" (correct). "i'll" inside "i'll" fine. Any contraction embedded in a non-word context? e.g. "he'll" is a substring of "she'll" → fine. What about "won't" in "knowsn't"? Not a word. So a word-boundary single-pass is equivalent for real text, and safer. I'll add \b boundaries. Wait — apostrophes: `\b` before "don't" — `\b` is between non-word and word; `'` is non-word, so `\bdon't\b` works for "I don't." Yes, `\b` before 'd' after apostrophe. And trailing `\b` after 't'. Good.

Actually, careful: `(?<![A-Za-z])` and `(?![A-Za-z])` lookarounds are more precise than `\b` because `'` is a word boundary char... e.g. "they've" contains "they" + "'ve". If I look for "you've" inside... no. Consider "he'd" inside "the'd"? not a word. `\b` would allow "n't" issues: e.g. text "ain't" — does any key match? "ain't" contains "n't"... keys like "don't" no. "can't" no. OK, but "it'll"? contains "it'll", and key "i'll" — with `\b` boundary, "it'll" → position of "i'll" at index 1; preceding char is 't' which is a word char, so `\b` fails → no match. Good, `\b` handles that correctly. Let me use lookarounds `(?<![A-Za-z])` ... `(?![A-Za-z])` to be safest — that's exactly what the dict's own `_LATIN_WORD` regex does. I'll use that.

3. Phrase lookup: full-text exact match first (`if t in self._phrases`) — the Python phrases dict includes PHRASES, cities_dict, game_names. In our port, phrases come from the multi-word keys of en_rus_full.json (plus single-word entries are in words). So exact-match check: if the whole normalized text is a key in the dict → return translation. Python checks `t in self._phrases` only, not `t in self._words`. Hmm, but words from EXTRA_WORDS/en_rus_full are not checked as full text... actually for a single word, `t in self._phrases` false, then word-by-word handles it. Fine — I'll check the full text against the dict (both phrase and word maps) which is a superset and better. Actually careful: it changes behavior for a single-word input: Python's word-by-word path drops articles. E.g. input "a" → full text "a" → words dict has "a" → "ПОЖАЛУЙСТА"?? Hmm, 'a' maps to 'ПОЖАЛУЙСТА' in the JSON (weird data). Python's path for "a": not in phrases → replace loop → split → w="a", pure="a", c="a" in _ARTICLES → dropped → result "". So exact full-text check against the words map would return "ПОЖАЛУЙСТА" for input "a". That differs. To stay faithful, the full-text fast path should only check the *phrase* map (multi-word keys), exactly like Python (`t in self._phrases`). I'll do: if multiword phrases map contains t → return. Otherwise proceed. And the article dropping then applies. Good — faithful.

4. Phrase replacement pass: instead of 6132 regex compilations, build a trie and scan tokens. Plan:
   - Tokenize the expanded text by whitespace into tokens (keeping them). But phrase matching must be able to span tokens and also match inside tokens? Python: `\bphrase\b` searched in the raw string — so a phrase could match mid-token, e.g. text "hello,good morning" — phrase "good morning" with \b boundaries: the char before "good" is "," → boundary ok, so it matches inside a comma-joined token. Also "good-morning": phrase "good morning" wouldn't match because "good" is followed by "-" (non-word) then "morning"... the phrase string has a space, and the text has "-", so no match. But `\bgood\b`... not relevant.

   So a pure whitespace-token trie would miss phrase matches that occur across punctuation without a space. To keep fidelity, I can do the phrase scan over the raw string with a trie walk on the char level, but a char-level trie over 6132 phrases with \b semantics is doable: walk the string, at each start position that is a word boundary, walk the trie char by char following letters (and the exact separator chars of phrase keys). Simpler and fast enough approach: split text into "word tokens" (maximal runs of letters) with positions, and build phrases as sequences of words (splitting phrase keys by non-letter separators). Then match sequences of consecutive word tokens with adjacency constraints. Hmm, adjacency: Python requires the exact text between words, i.e. the phrase key "good morning" requires literally "good morning" in the text, or "\bgood\nmorning"? `re.search(r'\bgood morning\b', text)` requires exact substring "good morning". So "good,morning" would NOT match. Whereas splitting the key "a la carte" into words requires a,la,carte with single spaces.

   Simplest faithful & fast approach: char-level trie over the phrase keys with a max key length guard. Let me do a hybrid that is both fast and faithful:
   - Build a trie keyed by characters over phrase keys (only phrases that survive tokenization: keys whose separators are exactly spaces? Let's include all keys — a trie handles any characters).
   - Scan: for i in 0 until n: if isWordBoundary(text, i-1) or i==0 (i.e. previous char is non-word or i==0... \b at i means text[i-1] is non-word or i==0; requires text[i] word char for \b to exist, but phrase keys start with letters so fine), walk the trie from i: node = root; j = i; while j<n and trie has child text[j] → node = child, j++. If node is terminal, record match (i, j) and track longest. Also need to prune: if the current node has no children, break.
   - Since keys contain spaces, the walk naturally requires the space characters. The word boundary check only at start; end boundary check when terminal: text[j] must be non-word or j==n.
   - Complexity: O(n * maxKeyLen) worst case but with trie pruning it's much less; plus early break when node has no children. For typical text this is microseconds. Good.

   Greedy longest match: Python sorts phrases by length desc and replaces each occurrence — which means the globally longest phrase at each position wins, and once replaced, placeholders are not re-scanned. Python's sequential approach differs subtly: a shorter phrase replaced earlier can block a longer overlapping phrase. E.g. text containing "to be" and "to be or not" — sorted desc so "to be or not" is replaced first. Then "to be" no longer matches inside the placeholder region. So sorted-desc + sequential is effectively longest-first. Greedy left-to-right longest match differs in rare overlapping cases (e.g. text "a b c": phrases "a b" and "b c" — Python: "a b" replaced first → "PH0 c"; then "b c" doesn't match. Greedy left-to-right: at pos 0 "a b" → same). Good enough and arguably better. I'll do greedy left-to-right, longest-at-position, non-overlapping — same as Python in nearly all cases, documented in a comment.

   Then output building: I need word-by-word translation of the remaining text. Approach: iterate over the string; when at a phrase match, append the phrase translation as one output item and jump; otherwise accumulate a "word chunk" of the plain text. Then split chunks on whitespace and process each token: pure = strip non-\w chars; if pure is article → drop; if pure in words → append translation; else if pure non-empty → append pure (note: Python appends `c` = pure, i.e. punctuation stripped, e.g. "hello," → "привет" without comma! Indeed `result.append(c)` where c is the cleaned word — so all punctuation is dropped from output. Except when token is a placeholder. Interesting: so "Hello, world!" → "привет мир" (no punctuation). That's the Python behavior — OCR text, and TTS doesn't need punctuation. I'll port faithfully.

   Wait, careful: for a word in `self._words`, Python appends `self._words[c]` — the pure word's translation. So punctuation dropped everywhere. Yes.

So for Russian input words, punctuation stripping keeps Cyrillic. In Kotlin, `\w` in java.util.regex is ASCII-only by default ([a-zA-Z_0-9]). Good — that matches Python's Unicode \w closely.

And `_load_json("cities_dict.json", self._phrases)`.

The ref result for 'a big fish' is 'большой ВЫТАСКИВАТЬ'?? That means "a big fish" phrase from PHRASES... no. Actually PHRASES from phrases_dict.py is checked in the full-text path `if t in self._phrases` — ref gives 'большой ВЫТАСКИВАТЬ' which looks like word-by-word: "a"→dropped? no, "a" is an article → dropped... Hmm "большой" = "big", "ВЫТАСКИВАТЬ" = "fish"? So the ref treated it word-by-word, and importantly did NOT match the "a big fish" phrase in en_rus_full.json (since en_rus_full was loaded into _words, not _phrases!).

Excellent — this gives me the house style, including a known pitfall: "На Android у org.json нет JSONObject(Reader), только (String) и (JSONTokener)" — read the asset to a String first. Same approach for 2.3 MB en_rus_full.json.

Now let me check the repo for docs/conventions in mobile_ocr_tts (maybe a NOTES.md) and check git log style. Also check if there's a `code/CLAUDE.md`/AGENTS.md with instructions.

Actually let's move on to writing the code. Plan for the three files.

### Contractions.kt

```kotlin
package com.screenocr.tts.translate

/**
 * Порт contractions.py ...
 */
object Contractions {
    private val MAP: Map<String, String> = mapOf(...)
    // single compiled alternation, longest first
    private val PATTERN: Pattern = buildPattern()

    fun expand(text: String): String { ... }
    fun size: Int
}
```

Also `fun isContraction(word: String): Boolean`? Not needed. Maybe expose `val size` for parity. I'll add `val size: Int get() = MAP.size` — harmless, useful for tests. Hmm, keep API minimal: `expand` + `size`. OK.

Building the pattern: keys sorted by length desc, escaped with Pattern.quote, joined with "|", wrapped in `(?<![A-Za-z])(...)(?![A-Za-z])`. Then use Matcher with appendReplacement/appendTail to avoid substring allocations. Using `matcher.replaceAll { }` isn't available in Java regex; in Kotlin I'd do a manual loop with `appendReplacement` and `Matcher.quoteReplacement`. Simpler: build a StringBuilder loop.

Note: also need to guard the pattern compile: if MAP were empty, Pattern with `()` would match empty. Not a concern but I'll handle by returning text unchanged if MAP is empty.

### OfflineDict.kt

```kotlin
class OfflineDict private constructor(...)
```

Requirements: "Класс/объект, который лениво грузит en_rus_full.json из assets". Needs Context for assets. Design:

```kotlin
class OfflineDict(context: Context) {
    companion object {
        fun get(context: Context): OfflineDict  // singleton per process
    }
    fun translate(text: String): String
    fun hasUntranslated(text: String): Boolean
    val size: Int
    val isLoaded: Boolean
    fun ensureLoaded() // internal, called from translate
    fun learn(key: String, translation: String)
}
```

Hmm — the required public API is `fun translate(text: String): String` and `val size: Int`. Since the constructor needs a Context, and callers (Translator) construct it, I'll do:

```kotlin
class OfflineDict(context: Context) {
    private val assets = context.applicationContext.assets
    ...
}
```

Threading: lazy load guarded by synchronized; `translate` is CPU work — Translator will call it inside `withContext(Dispatchers.Default)`. But translate() itself does the load; if a caller calls from main thread, the load would block. To be safe, provide `suspend fun ensureLoaded()` using Dispatchers.IO for the parse, and `translate` (sync) assumes loaded but calls `ensureLoadedBlocking()`? Hmm. Let's design:

- `suspend fun prepare()` → loads dictionary on Dispatchers.IO (idempotent). Translator calls it at the start of an offline translate.
- `fun translate(text: String): String` → uses `ensureLoaded()` which is synchronized double-checked lazy (blocking load if not yet prepared). This satisfies the required sync API.

To avoid a main-thread load crash, the `Translator` will call `prepare()` in a background dispatcher before use. Also, `translate` on the main thread after a `prepare()` won't block. Good; and if translate is called first from main, it blocks ~1s worst case but stays correct (Android's StrictMode would warn). Acceptable; document.

Trie implementation: to keep memory reasonable, use parallel arrays? A HashMap-based trie with 6132 phrases of avg 20 chars = ~120k nodes each with a HashMap → heavy (maybe 20+ MB). Better: a compact trie:

Option A: Node with `HashMap<Char, Int>` children + `value: String?`. Node objects: ~120k * (16 header + HashMap ~48 + ref) ≈ 10 MB. Meh.

Option B: Character-trie over a sorted flat array with binary search: classic "double-array"? complex.

Option C: Word-level trie (nodes = distinct words in phrases). 6132 phrases → how many distinct words? Let me compute. Node = word; children map word→node. Depth is number of words in the phrase (max 13). Number of nodes = number of distinct phrase prefixes ≈ maybe 12k. Each node: HashMap<String,Int> (48B) + value ref + terminal flag ≈ 100 B → 1.2 MB. 

But word-level matching needs to handle the exact separators of the phrase. Design: split each phrase key into tokens by whitespace → the phrase matches a run of consecutive input tokens, where the *joined text* must equal the key... Not exactly: Python required the literal substring. With word-token matching, "good morning" would match the input "good,morning" too (extra behavior, arguably better for OCR text where punctuation is adjacent). Hmm, that changes semantics vs Python but improves robustness. Is that acceptable? The task says "поиск многословных фраз (longest match)". A word-level trie longest-match is a faithful interpretation and more robust. Also it lets me do everything in a single token pass — clean, fast, no char-level scanning.

But careful: the *replacement* changes tokenization. In Python, after phrase replacement the placeholder tokens are checked. With a token pass, I just emit translations per token run.

Additional subtlety: Python lowercases and expands contractions, then phrases are matched on that string. So "let's" → "let us" happens before phrase matching — meaning a phrase containing "let us" could match. Faithful: expand first, then tokenize. But careful — if I tokenize the *original* text, contractions wouldn't be expanded. So: lowercase → Contractions.expand → tokenize into words (maximal runs of word chars, recording them plus the punctuation between). Hmm, but the Python punctuation handling: token = whitespace-split chunk; then `pure` = strip non-word chars. So a whitespace chunk "hello,world" (no space) is ONE token with pure "helloworld" — which would not be found in the dict! Let me check: Python `re.sub(r'[^\w]','', "hello,world")` = "helloworld", not in dict → appended as "helloworld". So Python's word splitting is whitespace-based, not character-based.

Hmm. Which to choose? If I use a character-based tokenizer (maximal runs of word chars), "hello,world" → two words → "привет мир". Python gives "helloworld". For OCR text, commas usually are followed by spaces, but not always (e.g. "Level 5,Boss"). Character-based tokenization is clearly better behavior for OCR. And with character-based tokens, the phrase matching also naturally handles "good,morning" → matches "good morning" phrase. I think character-based tokenization is the better engineering choice and I'll document the deviation in a comment (Python: whitespace split; Kotlin: split on non-word chars, which additionally handles text without spaces after punctuation — typical for OCR).

Hmm, but "Никаких заглушек" and faithfulness... The user's spec: "lowercase → раскрытие сокращений → поиск многословных фраз (longest match) → пословный перевод с отбрасыванием артиклей the/a/an → сборка результата". This describes exactly the char-token approach, no mention of the placeholder trick. I'm comfortable.

So algorithm:
1. `if (text.isEmpty()) return ""`
2. `val t = Contractions.expand(text.lowercase().trim())` — wait, expand already needs the text; do lowercase+trim then expand. Note Python does `.lower().strip()` then replaces. Do the same.
3. Direct whole-text hit: `words[key] ?: learned[key]` where key = t. Careful: Python checks `t in self._phrases` only (exact full text). With my merged map, checking exact full-text against the merged map would give "ПРИВЕТ" for "hello" (bypassing article dropping) — earlier I decided to only check multiword. But now with char-tokenization, what about a single-word text "a"? If I only check the phrase map, "a" → article → dropped → "". Same as Python. So: exact-hit check on the *phrase* map only. Hmm, but what about the learned map — Python checks learned for any text (`if t in self._learned`). Learned entries are full normalized strings from online translations, so a learned single-word entry should be returned directly. I'll check learned for any t (faithful), and phrases only for multiword. Let me be precise:

```
learned[t]?.let { return it }
if (t contains ' ') phrases[t]?.let { return it }   // by construction phrase map only has multiword keys
```
Since my phrase map contains only multiword keys (keys with a space... but char-tokenized multiword phrases can also be like "don't"? no, contractions are expanded; what about keys with hyphens like "well-known"? single token → word map. But careful: keys like "a la carte" contain spaces. And keys like "o'clock"? contains apostrophe, single token → word map. Hmm: a phrase key may contain no space but be multi-token under char tokenization, e.g. "don't,stop"? Let me just define: keys whose char-token count > 1 go to the phrase trie; keys with exactly 1 token go to the word map. Then the exact-hit check = `t` in phrase map (which requires the whole normalized text to be a phrase) OR in learned. Since the phrase map only holds multi-token keys, single-word texts skip the exact check → article dropping applies. 

Wait, but there's a subtlety: a phrase key like "a big fish" has 3 tokens. Text "a big fish" → exact hit → "рыбина". Python gave "большой ВЫТАСКИВАТЬ" (word-by-word, since en_rus_full phrases weren't in _phrases). Mine gives the dictionary phrase. Better.

4. Tokenize `t` into a list of `Tok(start, end, text)` of word-char runs. Then walk: at token i, try longest match in the phrase trie (greedy by token count), up to maxPhraseLen. If matched with k tokens → emit phrase translation, i += k. Else single token: strip? tokens are already pure word chars. Drop articles. Look up words map. If missing → append the token text (Python appends `c` if non-empty). Emit.
5. Join with " ".

Trie structure (word-level, max 13 tokens deep): 
```kotlin
private class PhraseNode {
    val children = HashMap<String, PhraseNode>()
    var value: String? = null
}
```
Greedy longest match: from node, walk children as deep as possible while children contains token, tracking the deepest node with value != null. Then back off to the deepest value. Implementation: keep `bestEnd` and `bestValue` locals. Careful: greedy must prefer longest *with* a value. Standard approach: 

```
var node = root; var bestLen = 0; var bestVal: String? = null
for (j in i until min(i + maxLen, tokens.size)) {
    val child = node.children[tokens[j]] ?: break
    node = child
    if (node.value != null) { bestLen = j - i + 1; bestVal = node.value }
}
```
This requires a terminal node's children to still be explored (yes, we continue walking). Good.

Also a fast pre-check: if root has no children for tokens[i], no match.

Performance: for each token, a HashMap lookup per candidate length. ~O(n*maxLen) worst, typically O(n). Microseconds. 

Memory: fine.

Now, the `size` property: total entries = words.size + phrases.size + learned.size? The requirement: "плюс val size: Int". I'll return the dictionary size (words + phrases), i.e. entries loaded from en_rus_full.json. Document it.

Also `phraseCount` maybe useful. I'll add `val size` and `val phraseCount` (documented). Hmm, minimal: `size` only, plus `isLoaded`? I'll include `isLoaded` because Translator/logs may want it, and it's used in `prepare()`. Let me include a small set: `size`, `isLoaded`, `translate`, `hasUntranslated`, `learn`, `prepare`, plus `get(context)` singleton. That's reasonable and each is real.

The learned dict: port `_learned` (load from filesDir/learned_dict.json, save on learn).     private data class HttpResult(val code: Int, val body: String)

    private suspend fun post(url: String, json: String, headers: Map<String, String> = emptyMap(), client: OkHttpClient = http): HttpResult {
        val body = json.toRequestBody(JSON_MEDIA_TYPE)
        val builder = Request.Builder().url(url).post(body)
        headers.forEach { (k, v) -> builder.header(k, v) }
        return execute(builder.build(), client)
    }

    private suspend fun get(url: HttpUrl, client: OkHttpClient = http): HttpResult {
        val builder = Request.Builder().url(url).get()
        return execute(builder.build(), client)
    }

    private suspend fun execute(request: Request, client: OkHttpClient): HttpResult =
        suspendCancellableCoroutine { cont ->
            val call = client.newCall(request)
            cont.invokeOnCancellation { call.cancel() }
            call.enqueue(object : Callback {
                override fun onFailure(call: Call, e: IOException) {
                    if (cont.isActive) cont.resumeWithException(e)
                }
                override fun onResponse(call: Call, response: Response) {
                    // Тело читаем здесь: колбэк okhttp приходит уже не в UI-потоке,
                    // а cont.resume переключит вызывающего обратно в его dispatcher.
                    val result = try {
                        response.use { HttpResult(it.code, it.body?.string() ?: "") }
                    } catch (e: IOException) {
                        cont.resumeWithException(e); return
                    }
                    if (cont.isActive) cont.resumeWith(Result.success(result))
                }
            })
        }

package com.screenocr.tts.translate

import java.util.regex.Matcher
import java.util.regex.Pattern

/**
 * Порт `contractions.py` — раскрытие английских сокращений.
 *
 * Словарь перенесён полностью (47 записей). Отличие от оригинала: вместо
 * последовательного `str.replace` на каждое сокращение (47 проходов по строке)
 * один раз собирается alternation-регекс, и подстановка делается одним
 * `Matcher.appendReplacement`-проходом. Границы `(?<![A-Za-z])…(?![A-Za-z])`
 * не дают разорвать слова: в `it'll` сокращение `i'll` не срабатывает.
 *
 * Регекс регистронезависимый, поэтому [expand] корректен и для исходного
 * регистра текста (`Let's` → `let us`).
 */
object Contractions {

    /** Словарь сокращений: оригинал → развёрнутая форма. */
    val DICT: Map<String, String> = mapOf(
        "let's" to "let us",
        "don't" to "do not",
        "doesn't" to "does not",
        "didn't" to "did not",
        "won't" to "will not",
        "can't" to "cannot",
        "couldn't" to "could not",
        "wouldn't" to "would not",
        "shouldn't" to "should not",
        "isn't" to "is not",
        "aren't" to "are not",
        "wasn't" to "was not",
        "weren't" to "were not",
        "haven't" to "have not",
        "hasn't" to "has not",
        "hadn't" to "had not",
        "i'm" to "i am",
        "you're" to "you are",
        "he's" to "he is",
        "she's" to "she is",
        "it's" to "it is",
        "we're" to "we are",
        "they're" to "they are",
        "i've" to "i have",
        "you've" to "you have",
        "we've" to "we have",
        "they've" to "they have",
        "i'll" to "i will",
        "you'll" to "you will",
        "he'll" to "he will",
        "she'll" to "she will",
        "we'll" to "we will",
        "they'll" to "they will",
        "i'd" to "i would",
        "you'd" to "you would",
        "he'd" to "he would",
        "she'd" to "she would",
        "we'd" to "we would",
        "they'd" to "they would",
        "that's" to "that is",
        "what's" to "what is",
        "who's" to "who is",
        "where's" to "where is",
        "when's" to "when is",
        "how's" to "how is",
        "there's" to "there is",
        "here's" to "here is",
    )

    /** Сколько сокращений в словаре (диагностика/тесты). */
    val size: Int get() = DICT.size

    /** Является ли строка сокращением (без учёта регистра). */
    fun isContraction(word: String): Boolean = DICT.containsKey(word.lowercase())

    /**
     * Один скомпилированный регекс на все сокращения. Варианты отсортированы
     * по убыванию длины, чтобы при совпадениях префиксов (нет, но подстраховка
     * от будущих записей) побеждал самый длинный вариант.
     */
    private val PATTERN: Pattern = buildPattern()

    private fun buildPattern(): Pattern {
        if (DICT.isEmpty()) return Pattern.compile("(?!)")
        val alternatives = DICT.keys
            .sortedByDescending { it.length }
            .joinToString("|") { Pattern.quote(it) }
        return Pattern.compile(
            "(?<![A-Za-z])($alternatives)(?![A-Za-z])",
            Pattern.CASE_INSENSITIVE,
        )
    }

    /** Раскрывает все сокращения в тексте за один проход. */
    fun expand(text: String): String {
        if (text.isEmpty()) return text
        val matcher = PATTERN.matcher(text)
        if (!matcher.find()) return text

        val out = StringBuilder(text.length + 16)
        do {
            val key = matcher.group(1) ?: ""
            // Ветка «не найдено в DICT» недостижима: регекс собран из ключей
            // словаря, но без !! на случай будущих не-alternation-паттернов.
            val replacement = DICT[key] ?: DICT[key.lowercase()] ?: key
            matcher.appendReplacement(out, Matcher.quoteReplacement(replacement))
        } while (matcher.find())
        matcher.appendTail(out)
        return out.toString()
    }
}

T would be inferred as Boolean from the expected return type of the `try` expression? Hmm. Kotlin infers T from the expected type Boolean → T = Boolean. The issue: `withContext(Dispatchers.IO) { block() }` — the lambda's return type can't be inferred as T because `withContext` is generic `withContext(context, block: suspend CoroutineScope.() -> T): T`, and inside the lambda `block()` returns T... but the expected type from the function's declared return type Boolean isn't propagated into the nested generic call. So `withContext(...)` infers `Any?` (from the lambda's expected type Unit?).

Fix: make it explicit:
```kotlin
    private suspend fun <T> probe(name: String, block: suspend () -> T): Boolean = try {
        withContext(Dispatchers.IO) { block() } as Boolean  // ugly
```
Better: constrain T to Boolean:
```kotlin
    private suspend fun probe(name: String, block: suspend () -> Boolean): Boolean = try {
        withContext(Dispatchers.IO) { block() }
    ...
```
With T = Boolean fixed, `withContext(Dispatchers.IO) { block() }` infers Boolean. That's cleaner anyway since probe is only used with Boolean blocks. Let me do that.

     */
    fun hasUntranslated(text: String): Boolean {
        val result = translate(text)
        if (result.isEmpty()) return true
        val resultWords = words(result)
        for (chunk in resultWords) {
            val latinLettersOnly = chunk.length > 2 &&
                chunk.all { it.code < 128 } &&

        if (resultWords.size < words(text).size * 0.4) return true

    }

"""
Screen OCR + TTS — MORT-style launcher
"""
import sys
import os
import logging
import tempfile
import faulthandler
from PyQt6.QtWidgets import QApplication, QMessageBox
from PyQt6.QtCore import Qt, QTimer

# gui_compact imported FIRST: it pulls QtWebEngineWidgets at module level,
# which Qt requires BEFORE any QCoreApplication/QApplication instance exists.
from gui_compact import CompactWindow

from settings import Settings

LOCK_FILE = os.path.join(tempfile.gettempdir(), "screen_ocr_tts.lock")


def check_already_running():
    try:
        if sys.platform == 'win32':
            import msvcrt
        else:
            import fcntl
        lock_fd = open(LOCK_FILE, 'w')
        if sys.platform == 'win32':
            msvcrt.locking(lock_fd.fileno(), msvcrt.LK_NBLCK, 1)
        else:
            fcntl.flock(lock_fd.fileno(), fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
        return lock_fd
    except (IOError, OSError):
        return None


def setup_logging():
    settings = Settings()
    log_level = settings.get("general.log_level", "INFO")
    level = getattr(logging, log_level.upper(), logging.INFO)
    logger = logging.getLogger()
    logger.setLevel(level)
    logger.handlers.clear()

    class SafeStreamHandler(logging.StreamHandler):
        def emit(self, record):
            try:
                msg = self.format(record)
                stream = self.stream
                stream.write(msg + self.terminator)
                self.flush()
            except UnicodeEncodeError:
                try:
                    stream.write(record.getMessage().encode('utf-8', errors='replace').decode('utf-8') + '\n')
                except Exception:
                    pass
            except Exception:
                self.handleError(record)

    ch = SafeStreamHandler(sys.stdout)
    ch.setLevel(level)
    ch.setFormatter(logging.Formatter('%(asctime)s - %(name)s - %(levelname)s - %(message)s'))
    logger.addHandler(ch)

    # Prevent non-fatal logging errors in threads from killing the process
    logging.raiseExceptions = False

    if settings.get("general.log_enabled", True):
        from logging.handlers import RotatingFileHandler
        fh = RotatingFileHandler(
            'screen_ocr.log', encoding='utf-8', mode='a',
            maxBytes=5 * 1024 * 1024, backupCount=5
        )
        fh.setLevel(level)
        fh.setFormatter(logging.Formatter('%(asctime)s - %(name)s - %(levelname)s - %(message)s'))
        logger.addHandler(fh)


def main():
    lock_fd = check_already_running()
    if lock_fd is None:
        try:
            app = QApplication.instance() or QApplication(sys.argv)
            QMessageBox.warning(None, "Screen OCR + TTS", "Already running!")
        except Exception:
            pass
        sys.exit(0)

    setup_logging()
    logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

    def _excepthook(exc_type, exc_value, exc_tb):
        import traceback
        logger.error("Unhandled:", exc_info=(exc_type, exc_value, exc_tb))
        traceback.print_exception(exc_type, exc_value, exc_tb)
    sys.excepthook = _excepthook

    # Catch unhandled exceptions in daemon threads (prevents silent crash)
    import threading
    _orig_thread_init = threading.Thread.__init__
    def _safe_thread_init(self, *args, **kwargs):
        _orig_thread_init(self, *args, **kwargs)
        _orig_run = self.run
        def _safe_run():
            try:
                _orig_run()
            except Exception as e:
                logger.error(f"Thread crash: {e}", exc_info=True)
        self.run = _safe_run
    threading.Thread.__init__ = _safe_thread_init

    logger.info("Starting Screen OCR + TTS (MORT style)")

    app = QApplication(sys.argv)
    app.setApplicationName("Screen OCR + TTS")
    app.setStyle("Fusion")

    # ── Hang detector (watchdog) ───────────────────────────
    # Dumps every thread's stack to hang_trace.txt only when the GUI
    # event loop is genuinely stuck (not processing 1s keepalive timer).
    import sys as _sys, threading as _threading, time as _time
    _main_alive = {"t": _time.time()}

    def _mark_alive():
        _main_alive["t"] = _time.time()

    _ka_timer = QTimer()
    _ka_timer.timeout.connect(_mark_alive)
    _ka_timer.start(1000)

    def _hang_watchdog():
        _trace_path = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)),
                                   "hang_trace.txt")
        while True:
            _time.sleep(3)
            if _time.time() - _main_alive["t"] > 12:
                try:
                    frames = _sys._current_frames()
                    with open(_trace_path, "a", buffering=1) as _f:
                        _f.write("\n=== HANG DETECTED %s ===\n" %
                                 _time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"))
                        for _tid, _fr in frames.items():
                            _f.write(f"\n--- Thread {_tid} ---\n")
                            import traceback as _tb
                            _tb.print_stack(_fr, file=_f)
                except Exception:
                    pass
                break

    _threading.Thread(target=_hang_watchdog, daemon=True).start()

    from PyQt6.QtGui import QPalette, QColor
    palette = QPalette()
    palette.setColor(QPalette.ColorRole.Window, QColor("#1e1e1e"))
    palette.setColor(QPalette.ColorRole.WindowText, QColor("#d4d4d4"))
    palette.setColor(QPalette.ColorRole.Base, QColor("#1e1e1e"))
    palette.setColor(QPalette.ColorRole.AlternateBase, QColor("#2d2d30"))
    palette.setColor(QPalette.ColorRole.Text, QColor("#d4d4d4"))
    palette.setColor(QPalette.ColorRole.Button, QColor("#0e639c"))
    palette.setColor(QPalette.ColorRole.ButtonText, QColor("#ffffff"))
    palette.setColor(QPalette.ColorRole.Highlight, QColor("#264f78"))
    palette.setColor(QPalette.ColorRole.HighlightedText, QColor("#ffffff"))
    app.setPalette(palette)

    window = CompactWindow()
    window.setStyleSheet(window._mort_theme())
    window.show()
    window.raise_()
    window.activateWindow()
    window.setFocus()

    logger.info("Ready")
    sys.exit(app.exec())


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

    out=[]

"""
Оверлей - прозрачное окно поверх игры для отображения распознанного текста
"""
import logging
from PyQt6.QtWidgets import (
    QLabel, QWidget, QVBoxLayout, QApplication, 
    QFrame, QGraphicsOpacityEffect
)
from PyQt6.QtCore import Qt, QTimer, QPoint, QPropertyAnimation, QEasingCurve, QRectF, QRect
from PyQt6.QtGui import QFont, QColor, QPainter, QBrush, QPainterPath

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


class OverlayWidget(QWidget):
    """Прозрачное окно для отображения текста поверх игр"""
    
    def __init__(self, settings):
        super().__init__()
        self.settings = settings
        self.visible = settings.get("overlay.enabled", True)
        self.text = ""
        self.current_opacity = settings.get("overlay.opacity", 0.8)
        
        self._setup_ui()
        self._apply_styles()
    
    def _setup_ui(self):
        """Настройка интерфейса"""
        self.setWindowFlags(
            Qt.WindowType.FramelessWindowHint |
            Qt.WindowType.WindowStaysOnTopHint |
            Qt.WindowType.Tool
        )
        self.setAttribute(Qt.WidgetAttribute.WA_TranslucentBackground)
        self.setAttribute(Qt.WidgetAttribute.WA_ShowWithoutActivating)
        
        layout = QVBoxLayout(self)
        layout.setContentsMargins(10, 10, 10, 10)
        layout.setSpacing(5)
        
        self.text_container = QFrame()
        
        text_layout = QVBoxLayout(self.text_container)
        text_layout.setContentsMargins(15, 10, 15, 10)
        
        self.text_label = QLabel("Нажмите F9 для распознавания")
        self.text_label.setWordWrap(True)
        self.text_label.setStyleSheet("color: white; background: transparent;")
        
        text_layout.addWidget(self.text_label)
        layout.addWidget(self.text_container)
        
        self.opacity_effect = QGraphicsOpacityEffect(self)
        self.opacity_effect.setOpacity(self.current_opacity)
        self.setGraphicsEffect(self.opacity_effect)
        
        self.update_timer = QTimer()
        self.update_timer.timeout.connect(self._animate_update)
        
        self.setMinimumWidth(300)
        self.setMaximumWidth(800)
        self.adjustSize()
        
        self._update_position()
    
    def _apply_styles(self):
        """Применение стилей"""
        font_size = self.settings.get("overlay.font_size", 14)
        font_color = self.settings.get("overlay.font_color", "#FFFFFF")
        bg_color = self.settings.get("overlay.background_color", "#000000AA")
        self.current_opacity = self.settings.get("overlay.opacity", 0.8)
        
        font = QFont("Segoe UI", font_size)
        self.text_label.setFont(font)
        self.text_label.setStyleSheet(f"color: {font_color}; background: transparent;")
        
        # Применяем текущую прозрачность
        self.opacity_effect.setOpacity(self.current_opacity)
        
        # Обновляем фон с текущей прозрачностью
        self._update_background_color()
    
    def _update_background_color(self):
        """Обновление цвета фона с текущей прозрачностью"""
        bg_color = self.settings.get("overlay.background_color", "#000000")
        if not bg_color.startswith("#"):
            bg_color = "#000000"
        
        hex_color = bg_color[1:]
        if len(hex_color) == 6:
            r = int(hex_color[0:2], 16)
            g = int(hex_color[2:4], 16)
            b = int(hex_color[4:6], 16)
            a = int(self.current_opacity * 255)
            bg_rgba = f"rgba({r}, {g}, {b}, {a})"
            self.text_container.setStyleSheet(
                f"background-color: {bg_rgba}; "
                "border-radius: 10px; "
                "border: 2px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 100);"
            )
    
    def set_opacity(self, opacity: float):
        """Установка прозрачности (0.0 - 1.0)"""
        self.current_opacity = max(0.0, min(1.0, opacity))
        self.opacity_effect.setOpacity(self.current_opacity)
        self._update_background_color()
        self.settings.set("overlay.opacity", self.current_opacity)
        logger.info(f"Прозрачность оверлея: {self.current_opacity:.1f}")
    
    def _update_position(self):
        """Обновление позиции оверлея"""
        position = self.settings.get("overlay.position", "top-right")
        
        screen = QApplication.primaryScreen().geometry()
        screen_width = screen.width()
        screen_height = screen.height()
        
        self.adjustSize()
        overlay_width = self.width()
        overlay_height = self.height()
        
        margin = 20
        
        if position == "top-right":
            x = screen_width - overlay_width - margin
            y = margin
        elif position == "top-left":
            x = margin
            y = margin
        elif position == "bottom-right":
            x = screen_width - overlay_width - margin
            y = screen_height - overlay_height - margin
        elif position == "bottom-left":
            x = margin
            y = screen_height - overlay_height - margin
        else:
            x = screen_width // 2 - overlay_width // 2
            y = screen_height // 2 - overlay_height // 2
        
        self.move(x, y)
    
    def show_text(self, text: str):
        """Отображение текста с анимацией"""
        self.text = text
        
        if not text:
            self.text_label.setText("Нет текста для отображения")
        else:
            max_length = 800
            if len(text) > max_length:
                text = text[:max_length] + "..."
            self.text_label.setText(text)
        
        if self.visible:
            self._animate_show()
    
    def _animate_show(self):
        """Анимация появления"""
        if not self.visible:
            return
        
        # Прячем оверлей чтобы перезапустить анимацию
        super().hide()
        
        # Показываем без анимации сначала
        super().show()
        
        # Запускаем анимацию прозрачности
        self.fade_animation = QPropertyAnimation(self.opacity_effect, b"opacity")
        self.fade_animation.setDuration(300)
        self.fade_animation.setStartValue(0)
        self.fade_animation.setEndValue(self.current_opacity)
        self.fade_animation.setEasingCurve(QEasingCurve.Type.InOutQuad)
        self.fade_animation.start()
    
    def _animate_update(self):
        """Обновление позиции оверлея при изменении экрана"""
        self._update_position()
    
    def toggle_visibility(self):
        """Переключение видимости"""
        self.visible = not self.visible
        if self.visible:
            self._animate_show()
        else:
            super().hide()
    
    def hide(self):
        """Скрытие оверлея"""
        super().hide()
    
    def show(self):
        """Показ оверлея без рекурсии"""
        super().show()
        self._apply_win32_styles()
        if self.visible:
            self._animate_show()

    def _apply_win32_styles(self):
        """WS_EX_NOACTIVATE + WS_EX_TOOLWINDOW для fullscreen-игр."""
        try:
            import ctypes
            hwnd = int(self.winId())
            GWL_EXSTYLE = -20
            WS_EX_NOACTIVATE = 0x08000000
            WS_EX_TOOLWINDOW = 0x00000080
            flags = WS_EX_NOACTIVATE | WS_EX_TOOLWINDOW
            old = ctypes.windll.user32.GetWindowLongW(hwnd, GWL_EXSTYLE)
            ctypes.windll.user32.SetWindowLongW(hwnd, GWL_EXSTYLE, old | flags)
        except Exception:
            pass
