# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""
Тест потоковой разбивки длинной реплики.

Проблема, которую проверяем: раньше реплика озвучивалась только ПОСЛЕ конца
фразы (ждали 450 мс тишины + 0.7 c idle), поэтому задержка = длина реплики.
Новый режим режет реплику по естественной паузе ВНУТРИ неё и начинает
озвучку, пока пользователь ещё говорит.

Ожидание:
  1) первая часть распознана ДО конца аудио (низкая задержка);
  2) в сумме кусков есть слова И начала, И конца реплики (ничего не потеряно);
  3) нет повторов (поток не дублирует текст).

Запуск: venv311\Scripts\python.exe test_streaming_chunks.py
"""
import asyncio
import io
import sys
import threading
import time

import numpy as np

if not (getattr(sys.stdout, "encoding", "") or "").lower().startswith("utf-8"):
    sys.stdout = io.TextIOWrapper(sys.stdout.buffer, encoding="utf-8",
                                  errors="replace")

SR = 16000


def _tts_audio(text, voice="en-US-BrianMultilingualNeural"):
    import av
    import edge_tts

    async def grab():
        data = b""
        async for ch in edge_tts.Communicate(text, voice).stream():
            if ch["type"] == "audio":
                data += ch["data"]
        return data

    raw = asyncio.run(grab())
    with av.open(io.BytesIO(raw)) as container:
        resampler = av.AudioResampler(format="s16", layout="mono", rate=SR)
        parts = []
        for frame in container.decode(audio=0):
            for rf in resampler.resample(frame):
                parts.append(rf.to_ndarray().reshape(-1))
    a = np.concatenate(parts).astype(np.float32) / 32768.0
    return a / (float(np.abs(a).max()) or 1.0) * 0.85


def main():
    from voice_translator import VoiceTranslator

    # Одна длинная реплика из НЕСКОЛЬКИХ фраз: после точки Edge-TTS кладёт
    # натуральную паузу — это и есть внутренняя граница для потока.
    # Реплика длинная (10+ c), иначе выигрыш невозможно измерить: на короткой
    # фразе даже медленный STT успевает раньше, чем реплика кончится.
    line = ("We should meet at the old bridge tomorrow. "
            "Are you bringing the map with you? "
            "I found some old coins near the river bank. "
            "We can trade them at the shop in the morning.")
    print("1) Синтез одной длинной реплики с паузами внутри...")
    a = _tts_audio(line)
    total = len(a) / SR
    print(f"   длительность: {total:.2f}s")
    if total < 8.0:
        print(f"[WARN] реплика слишком короткая ({total:.2f}s) для проверки")

    vt = VoiceTranslator()
    vt.set_languages("en", "ru")
    vt.set_vad(True)
    vt.set_model("tiny")
    vt.tts = None                      # озвучка тут не нужна, только текст
    vt._dst_lang = "ru"

    if not vt._ensure_whisper():
        print("[ERR] Whisper не загрузился")
        return 1

    # событие: (время, сколько аудио уже подано, текст)
    events = []
    fed = {"sec": 0.0}
    lock = threading.Lock()

    def on_heard(t, lang="", spk=""):
        with lock:
            events.append((time.time(), fed["sec"], t))

    vt.on_heard = on_heard

    # Момент РАЗРЕЗА: сколько аудио было подано, когда кусок пошёл в STT.
    # Именно это определяет задержку: озвучка первого куска не может
    # начаться раньше, чем он распознан.
    cuts = []
    orig_process = vt._process_chunk

    def timed_process(audio, sr):
        with lock:
            cuts.append((fed["sec"], len(audio) / float(sr)))
        return orig_process(audio, sr)

    vt._process_chunk = timed_process

    vt._running = True
    threading.Thread(target=vt._process_loop, daemon=True).start()
    time.sleep(0.5)

    print("2) Подача аудио в реальном времени (тишина не передаётся)...")
    step = int(0.3 * SR)
    t0 = time.time()
    for pos in range(0, len(a), step):
        piece = a[pos:pos + step]
        peak = float(np.abs(piece).max()) if len(piece) else 0.0
        if peak < 0.005:               # как фильтр в game_audio_capture
            fed["sec"] = pos / SR
            time.sleep(0.3)
            continue
        vt._audio_queue.put((piece, SR))
        fed["sec"] = (pos + len(piece)) / SR
        time.sleep(0.3)
    print(f"   аудио подано за {time.time() - t0:.1f}s")

    # ждём ВСЕ куски: после подачи аудио последний кусок ещё распознаётся
    # (STT на CPU медленнее реального времени), поэтому просто ждём, пока
    # новые события перестанут приходить.
    deadline = time.time() + 25.0
    last_n = -1
    quiet_since = time.time()
    while time.time() < deadline:
        with lock:
            n = len(events)
        if n != last_n:
            last_n = n
            quiet_since = time.time()
        elif n > 0 and time.time() - quiet_since > 3.0:
            break        # всё распознано, событий нет 3 c
        time.sleep(0.2)
    vt._running = False
    time.sleep(0.5)

    print("\n--- Результат ---")
    ok = True
    if not cuts:
        print("  (ничего не распознано)")
    for i, (fsec, slen) in enumerate(cuts, 1):
        print(f"  кусок {i}: {slen:.2f}c аудио, начало озвучки на {fsec:.1f}s "
              f"из {total:.1f}s")
    for i, (ts, fsec, text) in enumerate(events, 1):
        print(f"    текст {i}: «{text}»")

    if not cuts:
        print("[ERR] ни одного куска")
        return 1

    # 1) низкая задержка: первый кусок распознан, пока реплика НЕ закончилась
    first_cut = cuts[0][0]
    if first_cut >= total - 0.6:
        print(f"[ERR] первый кусок ждал конца реплики ({first_cut:.1f}s "
              f"из {total:.1f}s) — потоковая разбивка не сработала")
        ok = False
    else:
        saved = total - first_cut
        print(f"[OK] первый кусок пошёл в озвучку на {first_cut:.1f}s из "
              f"{total:.1f}s — выигрыш {saved:.1f}s, конца фразы не ждём")

    # 1b) реплика реально разбилась на несколько кусков, а не одним
    if len(cuts) < 2:
        print(f"[ERR] реплика не разбита на куски (кусков: {len(cuts)})")
        ok = False
    else:
        print(f"[OK] реплика разбита на {len(cuts)} кусков по паузам")

    # 2) ничего не потеряно: проверяем ВСЕ фразы реплики
    joined = " ".join(e[2] for e in events).lower()
    wanted = {
        "bridge": "начало",
        "map": "конец 1-й фразы",
        "coins": "конец 2-й фразы",
        "shop": "конец реплики",
    }
    missing = [f"{w} ({why})" for w, why in wanted.items() if w not in joined]
    if missing:
        print(f"[ERR] потеряны куски реплики: {', '.join(missing)}")
        ok = False
    else:
        print("[OK] все фразы реплики озвучены, ничего не потеряно")

    # 3) нет дублей: сравниваем СОСЕДНИЕ куски (частые слова типа «the»
    #    не считаем дублем — сравниваем долю общих слов подряд)
    STOP = {"the", "a", "an", "you", "i", "we", "is", "are", "at", "in",
            "to", "of", "it", "and", "do", "did", "can", "me", "my", "your"}
    texts = [e[2].lower() for e in events]
    dupe = False
    for a_txt, b_txt in zip(texts, texts[1:]):
        wa = {w.strip(".,!?") for w in a_txt.split()} - STOP
        wb = {w.strip(".,!?") for w in b_txt.split()} - STOP
        if not wa or not wb:
            continue
        inter = len(wa & wb)
        if inter >= 2 and inter / min(len(wa), len(wb)) > 0.6:
            print(f"[ERR] куски повторяются: «{a_txt}» / «{b_txt}»")
            dupe = True
    if dupe:
        ok = False
    else:
        print("[OK] повторов нет")

    print("\n[OK] ТЕСТ ПРОЙДЕН" if ok else "\n[ERR] ЕСТЬ ПРОБЛЕМЫ")
    return 0 if ok else 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

        if peak < 0.005:          # <- как фильтр в game_audio_capture

FEMALE_VOICE = "en-US-AvaMultilingualNeural"

     "Легендарный меч павшего короля способен победить тьму, которая угрожает нашему королевству"),

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""
Тест сегментации реплик и защиты от галлюцинаций.

Сценарий: 3 c музыки -> фраза EN -> 3 c музыки.
Ожидание: ровно ОДНА распознанная реплика (целая фраза), музыка игнорируется.

Запуск: venv311\Scripts\python.exe test_stt_segmentation.py
"""
import asyncio
import io
import sys
import threading
import time

import numpy as np

sys.stdout = io.TextIOWrapper(sys.stdout.buffer, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")

SR = 16000


def _tts_speech(text, voice="en-US-BrianMultilingualNeural"):
    import av
    import edge_tts

    async def grab():
        data = b""
        async for ch in edge_tts.Communicate(text, voice).stream():
            if ch["type"] == "audio":
                data += ch["data"]
        return data

    raw = asyncio.run(grab())
    with av.open(io.BytesIO(raw)) as container:
        stream = container.streams.audio[0]
        resampler = av.AudioResampler(format="s16", layout="mono", rate=SR)
        parts = []
        for frame in container.decode(audio=0):
            for rf in resampler.resample(frame):
                parts.append(rf.to_ndarray().reshape(-1))
    audio = np.concatenate(parts).astype(np.float32) / 32768.0
    peak = float(np.abs(audio).max()) or 1.0
    return audio / peak * 0.8


def _music(seconds, seed=0):
    t = np.arange(int(seconds * SR)) / SR
    rng = np.random.RandomState(seed)
    track = (0.30 * np.sin(2 * np.pi * 220 * t)
             + 0.20 * np.sin(2 * np.pi * 330 * t)
             + 0.15 * np.sin(2 * np.pi * 440 * t)
             + 0.05 * rng.randn(len(t)))
    track = track / max(1e-9, np.abs(track).max())
    return (track * 0.75).astype(np.float32)


def main():
    from voice_translator import VoiceTranslator

    print("1) Синтез речи (Edge-TTS)...")
    speech = _tts_speech("The scenery is wonderful, my friend.")
    print(f"   речь: {len(speech)/SR:.2f}s")

    track = np.concatenate([_music(3.0, 1), speech, _music(3.0, 2)])
    print(f"2) Микс: 3s музыка + речь + 3s музыка = {len(track)/SR:.2f}s")

    vt = VoiceTranslator()
    vt.set_languages("en", "ru")
    vt.set_vad(True)
    vt.set_model("tiny")
    vt.tts = None  # только STT, без озвучки

    heard = []
    vt.on_heard = lambda text, lang="", spk="": heard.append((text, spk))

    print("3) Загрузка Whisper tiny...")
    if not vt._ensure_whisper():
        print("[ERR] Whisper не загрузился")
        return 1

    vt._running = True
    thread = threading.Thread(target=vt._process_loop, daemon=True)
    thread.start()

    print("4) Подача аудио чанками по 0.3s (имитация live capture)...")
    step = int(0.3 * SR)
    for pos in range(0, len(track), step):
        vt._audio_queue.put((track[pos:pos + step], SR))
        time.sleep(0.3)
    time.sleep(3.0)  # дать дописать последнюю реплику
    vt._running = False
    time.sleep(0.5)

    print("\n--- Результат ---")
    for i, (text, spk) in enumerate(heard, 1):
        print(f"  реплика {i}: [{spk}] {text}")

    ok = True
    if len(heard) == 0:
        print("[WARN] Речь не распознана — проверьте аудио/VAD")
        ok = False
    elif len(heard) > 1:
        print(f"[ERR] Реплика разбита на {len(heard)} частей вместо одной")
        ok = False
    else:
        print("[OK] Ровно одна целая реплика, музыка проигнорирована")

    # Проверка анти-эха
    vt._recent_ru.append("Спасибо за внимание")
    if vt._looks_like_own_voice("Thanks for watching"):
        print("[ERR] Анти-эхо не работает")
        ok = False
    else:
        print("[OK] Чужой текст не считается эхом")

    if vt._looks_like_own_voice("спасибо за внимание."):
        print("[OK] Свой текст распознаётся как эхо и будет отброшен")
    else:
        print("[ERR] Свой текст не распознаётся как эхо")
        ok = False

    print("\n[OK] ТЕСТ ПРОЙДЕН" if ok else "\n[ERR] ЕСТЬ ПРОБЛЕМЫ")
    return 0 if ok else 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

42:         except Exception:
43:             pass
44:     logging.basicConfig(
45:         level=logging.INFO,
46:         format="%(asctime)s [%(name)s] %(levelname)s - %(message)s",
47:         handlers=handlers,

59:         me = psutil.Process()

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""
Headless voice translator — слушает игру и переводит EN->RU в реальном времени.
Без GUI. Запуск: python run_voice.py

Особенности:
  * один экземпляр: второй запуск завершится, а не создаст «диалог с собой»;
  * авто-определение активного игрового EXE (в т.ч. переключение, если сменился);
  * логи в UTF-8, чтобы русский перевод не превращался в кракозябры;
  * реплика сначала пишется текстом, потом озвучивается.
"""
import argparse
import io
import os
import sys
import time
import logging

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))

# Консоль cp1251 не умеет кириллицу -> принудительно UTF-8
try:
    sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
    sys.stderr.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
except Exception:
    try:
        sys.stdout = io.TextIOWrapper(
            sys.stdout.buffer, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
        sys.stderr = io.TextIOWrapper(
            sys.stderr.buffer, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
    except Exception:
        pass

logger = logging.getLogger("run_voice")


def _setup_logging():
    handlers = []
    for stream in (sys.stdout, sys.stderr):
        try:
            handlers.append(logging.StreamHandler(stream))
        except Exception:
            pass
    logging.basicConfig(
        level=logging.INFO,
        format="%(asctime)s [%(name)s] %(levelname)s - %(message)s",
        handlers=handlers,
        force=True,
    )


def _own_process_tree():
    """PID'ы нас и наших предков (venv-launcher тоже держит run_voice.py
    в командной строке — раньше guard считал его «вторым экземпляром»
    и сразу завершался)."""
    pids = {os.getpid()}
    try:
        import psutil
        me = psutil.Process()
        pids.add(me.pid)
        for parent in me.parents():
            pids.add(parent.pid)
    except Exception:
        pass
    return pids


def _is_run_voice_cmd(cmdline) -> bool:
    """Совпадает ли командная строка с запуском run_voice.py
    (а не test_run_voice.py и не упоминания в других аргументах)."""
    for part in cmdline or []:
        name = os.path.basename(str(part).replace("\\", "/"))
        if name == "run_voice.py":
            return True
    return False


def _other_instances():
    """Список PID других (чужих) запущенных экземпляров run_voice.py."""
    pids = []
    try:
        import psutil
    except ImportError:
        return pids
    own = _own_process_tree()
    for proc in psutil.process_iter(["pid", "name", "cmdline"]):
        try:
            if proc.info["pid"] in own:
                continue
            if _is_run_voice_cmd(proc.info.get("cmdline")):
                pids.append(proc.info["pid"])
        except Exception:
            continue
    return pids


def _pick_target_exe(exe_filter: str = None):
    """Найти PID процесса по имени exe (для --exe)."""
    try:
        import psutil
    except ImportError:
        return None, None
    for proc in psutil.process_iter(["pid", "name"]):
        try:
            name = proc.info.get("name") or ""
            if not exe_filter:
                continue
            if name.lower() == exe_filter.lower():
                return proc.info["pid"], name
        except Exception:
            continue
    return None, None


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Headless EN->RU voice translator")
    parser.add_argument("--exe", help="целевой exe, например GenshinImpact.exe")
    parser.add_argument("--model", default=None, help="Whisper: tiny/base/small")
    parser.add_argument("--no-tts", action="store_true", help="только текст, без озвучки")
    parser.add_argument("--subtitles", action="store_true",
                        help="читать субтитры с экрана: озвучивать, если голоса "
                             "нет, и уточнять распознавание, если есть и то "
                             "и другое")
    parser.add_argument("--sub-ocr-slow", action="store_true",
                        help="OCR субтитров без ускорения: нужен для "
                             "КИРИЛЛИЦЫ (медленный движок, но понимает "
                             "русские субтитры; по умолчанию быстрый "
                             "читает только латиницу)")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    _setup_logging()

    running = _other_instances()
    if running:
        logger.error(f"Уже запущен экземпляр run_voice.py: PID {running}. "
                     "Остановите его или не запускайте второй раз — иначе "
                     "переводчики слышат друг друга.")
        return 1

    from tts_engine import TTSEngine
    from settings import Settings

    settings = Settings()
    engine = TTSEngine(settings)
    engine.set_voice("en-US-BrianMultilingualNeural")  # EN+RU, один тембр
    engine.rate = 0

    from voice_translator import VoiceTranslator
    vt = VoiceTranslator()
    vt.tts = None if args.no_tts else engine

    # Переводчик ОБЯЗАТЕЛЕН: без него VoiceTranslator падал в офлайн-словарь,
    # который переводит пословно («Are you bringing the map?» ->
    # «являются Ю ПРИВЕДЕНИЕ карта»).
    # Цепочка: Zen (free, без ключа) -> Google -> DeepL -> offline.
    # OrcaRouter (404) и OpenRouter (403) удалены из проекта 26.09.2026.
    translator = None
    try:
        from translator import Translator, ZEN_MODELS
        translator = Translator()
        # Настройки лежат во вложенном словаре translation.*
        # Раньше читался несуществующий settings.translator_api_key, и
        # try/except молча съедал ошибку -> перевод шёл через мусорный Zen.
        zen_model = (settings.get("translation.zen_model", "") or "").strip()
        cfg = {
            "api_key": settings.get("translation.api_key", ""),
            "model": settings.get("translation.model", ""),
            # Пустая zen_model -> Translator сам берёт проверенную
            # space-bunny-free из ZEN_MODELS.
            "zen_model": zen_model,
        }
        translator.configure(**cfg)
        # Для озвучки словарь отключаем: пословный перевод хуже молчания
        if hasattr(translator, "allow_offline_dict"):
            translator.allow_offline_dict = False
        vt.translator = translator
        logger.info("Переводчик: Zen/%s (без ключа), fallback Google -> DeepL",
                    zen_model or ZEN_MODELS[0])
    except Exception as e:
        logger.warning(f"Сетевой переводчик недоступен ({e}) — будет офлайн-словарь")

    vt.set_languages("auto", "ru")   # авто-определение языка речи
    vt.set_dual_mode(False)   # озвучиваем только перевод
    vt.set_vad(True)
    if args.model:
        vt.set_model(args.model)

    if args.exe:
        pid, name = _pick_target_exe(args.exe)
        if pid:
            vt.set_target_pid(pid)
            logger.info(f"Целевой процесс по --exe: {name} (PID={pid})")
        else:
            logger.warning(f"Процесс {args.exe} не найден — будет авто-определение")

    def on_heard(text, lang="", speaker=""):
        logger.info("[HEARD]  [%s] %s  <%s>", lang, text, speaker or "?")

    def on_text(en, ru, lang="", speaker=""):
        # ru приходит позже оригинала (перевод идёт в фоне), поэтому
        # пока ru пуст, печатаем оригинал, а не пустую строку.
        if ru and ru.strip():
            logger.info("[RU]     %s", ru)
        else:
            logger.info("[ORIG]   %s", en)

    vt.on_heard = on_heard
    vt.on_text = on_text

    if args.subtitles:
        # Включаем ДО start(), чтобы поток субтитров поднялся сразу.
        vt.set_subtitles(True, settings, fast_ocr=not args.sub_ocr_slow)
        logger.info("Субтитры с экрана включены: фолбэк без голоса + "
                    "уточнение распознавания")

    logger.info("Запуск VoiceTranslator (Whisper грузится в фоне)...")
    vt.start()

    from game_audio_capture import game_audio
    time.sleep(1.0)
    if game_audio._game_pid:
        mode = "по процессу" if game_audio._proc_capture else "системный loopback"
        logger.info("Источник звука: %s (PID=%s), захват: %s",
                    game_audio._game_name, game_audio._game_pid, mode)
    else:
        logger.warning("Активный источник не найден — пишем всё, что слышно в системе")

    logger.info("Готово. Ctrl+C — остановка.")
    try:
        while True:
            time.sleep(1)
    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        logger.info("Остановка...")
    finally:
        try:
            vt.stop()
        except Exception as e:
            logger.warning(f"stop error: {e}")
        logger.info("Завершено.")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

display.text:
"""
Screen OCR + TTS — MORT-style launcher
"""
import sys
import os
import logging
import tempfile
import faulthandler
from PyQt6.QtWidgets import QApplication, QMessageBox
from PyQt6.QtCore import Qt, QTimer

# gui_compact imported FIRST: it pulls QtWebEngineWidgets at module level,
# which Qt requires BEFORE any QCoreApplication/QApplication instance exists.
from gui_compact import CompactWindow

from settings import Settings

LOCK_FILE = os.path.join(tempfile.gettempdir(), "screen_ocr_tts.lock")


def check_already_running():
    try:
        if sys.platform == 'win32':
            import msvcrt
        else:
            import fcntl
        lock_fd = open(LOCK_FILE, 'w')
        if sys.platform == 'win32':
            msvcrt.locking(lock_fd.fileno(), msvcrt.LK_NBLCK, 1)
        else:
            fcntl.flock(lock_fd.fileno(), fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
        return lock_fd
    except (IOError, OSError):
        return None


def setup_logging():
    settings = Settings()
    log_level = settings.get("general.log_level", "INFO")
    level = getattr(logging, log_level.upper(), logging.INFO)
    logger = logging.getLogger()
    logger.setLevel(level)
    logger.handlers.clear()

    class SafeStreamHandler(logging.StreamHandler):
        def emit(self, record):
            try:
                msg = self.format(record)
                stream = self.stream
                stream.write(msg + self.terminator)
                self.flush()
            except UnicodeEncodeError:
                try:
                    stream.write(record.getMessage().encode('utf-8', errors='replace').decode('utf-8') + '\n')
                except Exception:
                    pass
            except Exception:
                self.handleError(record)

    ch = SafeStreamHandler(sys.stdout)
    ch.setLevel(level)
    ch.setFormatter(logging.Formatter('%(asctime)s - %(name)s - %(levelname)s - %(message)s'))
    logger.addHandler(ch)

    # Prevent non-fatal logging errors in threads from killing the process
    logging.raiseExceptions = False

    if settings.get("general.log_enabled", True):
        from logging.handlers import RotatingFileHandler
        fh = RotatingFileHandler(
            'screen_ocr.log', encoding='utf-8', mode='a',
            maxBytes=5 * 1024 * 1024, backupCount=5
        )
        fh.setLevel(level)
        fh.setFormatter(logging.Formatter('%(asctime)s - %(name)s - %(levelname)s - %(message)s'))
        logger.addHandler(fh)


def main():
    lock_fd = check_already_running()
    if lock_fd is None:
        try:
            app = QApplication.instance() or QApplication(sys.argv)
            QMessageBox.warning(None, "Screen OCR + TTS", "Already running!")
        except Exception:
            pass
        sys.exit(0)

    setup_logging()
    logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

    def _excepthook(exc_type, exc_value, exc_tb):
        import traceback
        logger.error("Unhandled:", exc_info=(exc_type, exc_value, exc_tb))
        traceback.print_exception(exc_type, exc_value, exc_tb)
    sys.excepthook = _excepthook

    # Catch unhandled exceptions in daemon threads (prevents silent crash)
    import threading
    _orig_thread_init = threading.Thread.__init__
    def _safe_thread_init(self, *args, **kwargs):
        _orig_thread_init(self, *args, **kwargs)
        _orig_run = self.run
        def _safe_run():
            try:
                _orig_run()
            except Exception as e:
                logger.error(f"Thread crash: {e}", exc_info=True)
        self.run = _safe_run
    threading.Thread.__init__ = _safe_thread_init

    logger.info("Starting Screen OCR + TTS (MORT style)")

    app = QApplication(sys.argv)
    app.setApplicationName("Screen OCR + TTS")
    app.setStyle("Fusion")

    # ── Hang detector (watchdog) ───────────────────────────
    # Dumps every thread's stack to hang_trace.txt only when the GUI
    # event loop is genuinely stuck (not processing 1s keepalive timer).
    import sys as _sys, threading as _threading, time as _time
    _main_alive = {"t": _time.time()}

    def _mark_alive():
        _main_alive["t"] = _time.time()

    _ka_timer = QTimer()
    _ka_timer.timeout.connect(_mark_alive)
    _ka_timer.start(1000)

    def _hang_watchdog():
        _trace_path = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)),
                                   "hang_trace.txt")
        while True:
            _time.sleep(3)
            if _time.time() - _main_alive["t"] > 12:
                try:
                    frames = _sys._current_frames()
                    with open(_trace_path, "a", buffering=1) as _f:
                        _f.write("\n=== HANG DETECTED %s ===\n" %
                                 _time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"))
                        for _tid, _fr in frames.items():
                            _f.write(f"\n--- Thread {_tid} ---\n")
                            import traceback as _tb
                            _tb.print_stack(_fr, file=_f)
                except Exception:
                    pass
                break

    _threading.Thread(target=_hang_watchdog, daemon=True).start()

    from PyQt6.QtGui import QPalette, QColor
    palette = QPalette()
    palette.setColor(QPalette.ColorRole.Window, QColor("#1e1e1e"))
    palette.setColor(QPalette.ColorRole.WindowText, QColor("#d4d4d4"))
    palette.setColor(QPalette.ColorRole.Base, QColor("#1e1e1e"))
    palette.setColor(QPalette.ColorRole.AlternateBase, QColor("#2d2d30"))
    palette.setColor(QPalette.ColorRole.Text, QColor("#d4d4d4"))
    palette.setColor(QPalette.ColorRole.Button, QColor("#0e639c"))
    palette.setColor(QPalette.ColorRole.ButtonText, QColor("#ffffff"))
    palette.setColor(QPalette.ColorRole.Highlight, QColor("#264f78"))
    palette.setColor(QPalette.ColorRole.HighlightedText, QColor("#ffffff"))
    app.setPalette(palette)

    window = CompactWindow()
    window.setStyleSheet(window._mort_theme())
    window.show()
    window.raise_()
    window.activateWindow()
    window.setFocus()

    logger.info("Ready")
    sys.exit(app.exec())


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

    # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
    # AUTO-READ: реальное время — скан + сразу озвучка

    def _toggle_auto_read(self, checked=None):
        """Включение/выключение режима Auto-Read (F7).
        Непрерывно сканирует экран через GlensOCR и сразу озвучивает распознанный текст."""
        if checked is None:
            checked = not self._auto_read_active

        if checked:
            self._start_auto_read()
        else:
            self._stop_auto_read()

    def _start_auto_read(self):
        """Запуск Auto-Read: скан каждые N мс + TTS каждого нового текста."""
        if self._auto_read_active:
            return
        if not hasattr(self, 'ocr') or not self.ocr:
            self.status_label.setText("Auto-Read: OCR not ready")
            return

        self._auto_read_active = True
        self._auto_read_last_text = ""

        # Визуальная индикация — кнопка "горит"
        self.btn_auto_read.setChecked(True)
        self.btn_auto_read.setText(f"⏹ Stop")
        self.btn_auto_read.setStyleSheet(
            "QPushButton { background: #0d5a0d; color: #4cff4c; border: 2px solid #4cff4c; border-radius: 5px; font-weight: bold; }"
            "QPushButton:hover { background: #0a4a0a; }"
        )
        self.auto_read_led.setStyleSheet("color: #4cff4c; font-size: 14px;")
        self.auto_read_led.setToolTip("Auto-Read: ON — сканирует и озвучивает")

        # Показать панель статус-иконок
        if hasattr(self, 'status_icons'):
            self.status_icons.show_all_off()
            self.status_icons.show()
            self.status_icons.raise_()

        # Показать окно предпросмотра игры
        if hasattr(self, 'game_preview'):
            if self.regions:
                self.game_preview.set_region(self.regions[0])
            self.game_preview.show()
            self.game_preview.raise_()

        # Запуск TTS стриминга
        if hasattr(self, 'scanner') and self.scanner:
            try:
                import asyncio
                loop = asyncio.get_event_loop()
                if loop.is_running():
                    asyncio.ensure_future(self.scanner.start_tts_streaming())
            except Exception:
                pass

        # Таймер сканирования (каждые 800 мс)
        interval = self.interval.value() if hasattr(self, 'interval') else 800
        # Для GlensOCR (联网) — не чаще 1 раза в секунду
        interval = max(interval, 1000)
        self._auto_read_timer.start(interval)
        self.status_label.setText(f"Auto-Read: ON — скан каждые {interval}мс")

        # ══════ Запуск Voice Translator (VAD + STT) для лайв-звука ══════
        audio_lang = self.settings.get("game.audio_language", "auto")
        dual = self.settings.get("game.auto_repeat_en", False)
        vad = self.settings.get("game.voice_activity_detection", True)
        if audio_lang != "off":
            try:
                from voice_translator import voice_translator
                self._voice_translator = voice_translator
                voice_translator.tts = self.tts
                if audio_lang in ("en", "auto"):
                    voice_translator.set_languages("en", "ru")
                else:
                    voice_translator.set_languages(audio_lang, "ru")
                voice_translator.set_dual_mode(dual)
                voice_translator.set_vad(vad)
                voice_translator.on_voice_detected = lambda is_v: self._gui(
                    lambda iv=is_v: self.status_icons.pulse("voice", 500) if iv else None)
                voice_translator.start()
                logger.info(f"[AUTO-READ] VoiceTranslator started (audio={audio_lang}, dual={dual}, vad={vad})")
            except Exception as e:
                logger.warning(f"[AUTO-READ] VoiceTranslator start failed: {e}")

        logger.info(f"[AUTO-READ] Запущен (interval={interval}ms)")

    def _stop_auto_read(self):

So per-process capture is **permanently dead code**. Also note it requires build >= 19041 (2004) whereas the C# says 20348.

    def _start_process_capture(self, pid) -> bool:
        """Захват одного процесса + проверка, что звук реально пошёл."""
        pid = int(pid)
        # Этот API (AUDIOCLIENT_PROCESS_LOOPBACK) есть не на всех системах:
        # при отказе не пытаемся снова 5 минут, сразу работаем через loopback.
        bad = self._proc_failed.get(pid)
        if bad and (time.time() - bad[0]) < self._proc_retry_sec:
            return False

        self._proc_audio_seen = False
        try:
            capture = proc_cap_mod.ProcessLoopbackCapture(
                pid, self._on_proc_audio,
                silence_threshold=self._silence_threshold,
                on_error=self._on_proc_error)
            capture.start()
        except Exception as e:
            self._proc_failed[pid] = (time.time(), e)
            logger.warning(f"[GameAudio] Per-process init failed "
                           f"(fallback to loopback): {e}")
            return False

        self._proc_capture = capture
        # Health-check: падение/смерть потока ловим и откатываемся на loopback
        checker = threading.Thread(
            target=self._check_process_capture, args=(capture,), daemon=True)
        checker.start()
        logger.info(f"[GameAudio] Per-process capture started "
                    f"(PID={pid}, app={self._game_name})")
        return True

    def _check_process_capture(self, capture):
        """Health-check: откатываемся на loopback только при РЕАЛЬНОЙ поломке.

        Раньше проверка срабатывала, если за 5 c не пришёл не-тихий пакет, —
        но тишина в игре (загрузка, пауза диалога) не означает отказ захвата.
        Теперь ориентируемся на состояние API и ошибки, а не на громкость.
        """
        time.sleep(self._proc_check_sec)
        if not self._running or capture is not self._proc_capture:
            return

        failed = capture.last_error is not None or not capture.is_active()
        if failed:
            reason = capture.last_error or "capture thread is not active"
            logger.warning(f"[GameAudio] Per-process capture failed "
                           f"({reason}), falling back to system loopback")
            try:
                capture.stop()
            except Exception:
                pass
            if capture is self._proc_capture:
                self._proc_capture = None
            self._running = False
            self._start_loopback_capture()
            return

        if self._proc_audio_seen:
            logger.info("[GameAudio] Per-process capture is delivering audio")
        elif capture.packets_received:
            logger.info("[GameAudio] Per-process capture is alive "
                        f"({capture.packets_received} packets), source just quiet")
        else:
            logger.info("[GameAudio] Per-process capture is alive, "
                        "no packets yet (game idle) — keeping it")

    def _run(self):
        try:
            comtypes.CoInitializeEx(None, COINIT_MULTITHREADED)
        except Exception:
            try:
                comtypes.CoInitialize()
            except Exception:
                pass
        try:
            enum = comtypes.CoCreateInstance(
                CLSID_MMDeviceEnumerator, IMMDeviceEnumerator,
                comtypes.CLSCTX_ALL)
            endpoint = enum.GetDefaultAudioEndpoint(E_RENDER, E_CONSOLE)
            pp = c_void_p()
            endpoint.Activate(IID_IAudioClient2, CLSCTX_ALL, None, pp)
            client = comtypes.cast(pp, POINTER(IAudioClient2)).contents
            self._client = client

            props = AudioClientProperties()
            props.cbSize = ctypes.sizeof(AudioClientProperties)
            props.bIsProcessLoopback = 1
            props.ProcessLoopbackParams.ProcessId = c_ulong(self.pid)
            props.ProcessLoopbackParams.IncludeProcessTree = 1
            client.SetClientProperties(props)

            mixpp = POINTER(WAVEFORMATEX)()
            client.GetMixFormat(mixpp)
            fmt = mixpp.contents
            self.sample_rate = fmt.nSamplesPerSec
            self.channels = fmt.nChannels
            wave_fmt = fmt.wFormatTag
            if wave_fmt == WAVE_FORMAT_EXTENSIBLE:
                wave_fmt = WAVE_FORMAT_IEEE_FLOAT

            client.Initialize(
                AUDCLNT_SHAREMODE_SHARED, AUDCLNT_STREAMFLAGS_LOOPBACK,
                0, 0, fmt, None)

            srv = c_void_p()
            client.GetService(IID_IAudioCaptureClient, srv)
            cap = comtypes.cast(srv, POINTER(IAudioCaptureClient)).contents
            self._capture = cap

            client.Start()
            self._started = True
            logger.info(f"[ProcCapture] Capturing PID={self.pid} "
                        f"(sr={self.sample_rate}, ch={self.channels})")

            while self._running:
                nxt = c_uint32(0)
                cap.GetNextPacketSize(nxt)
                if nxt.value == 0:
                    continue
                ppdata = c_void_p()
                nframes = c_uint32(0)
                flags = c_uint32(0)
                cap.GetBuffer(ppdata, nframes, flags, None, None)
                try:
                    if nframes.value == 0:
                        continue
                    audio = self._to_float_mono(
                        ppdata, nframes.value, wave_fmt)
                    if audio is None:
                        continue
                    # Пакет пришёл => процесс-источник жив (даже если тихо)
                    self.packets_received += 1
                    self.last_packet_at = time.time()
                    peak = float(np.abs(audio).max())
                    if peak < self.silence_threshold:
                        continue
                    try:
                        self.callback(audio, self.sample_rate)
                    except Exception as e:
                        logger.warning(f"[ProcCapture] callback error: {e}")
                finally:
                    cap.ReleaseBuffer(nframes.value)
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"[ProcCapture] Capture error (PID={self.pid}): {e}")
            self.last_error = e
            # Notify owner so it can fall back to system loopback
            try:
                if self.on_error:
                    self.on_error(e)
            except Exception:
                pass
        finally:
            try:
                if self._client:
                    self._client.Stop()
            except Exception:
                pass
            self._running = False
            logger.info(f"[ProcCapture] Stopped (PID={self.pid})")

try:
    import pyaudiowpatch as pyaudio
    PYAUDIO_AVAILABLE = True
except ImportError:
    PYAUDIO_AVAILABLE = False

try:
    from pycaw.pycaw import AudioUtilities
    PYCAW_AVAILABLE = True
except ImportError:
    PYCAW_AVAILABLE = False

try:
    import process_audio_capture as proc_cap_mod
    PROC_CAP_AVAILABLE = True
except Exception:
    PROC_CAP_AVAILABLE = False


class GameAudioCapture:
    """
    Captures game audio via WASAPI loopback.
    Uses pycaw to identify game process audio sessions.
    Filters out silence and non-game audio.
    """

    def __init__(self):
        self._pa = None
        self._stream = None
        self._running = False
        self._game_pid = None
        self._game_name = None
        self._sample_rate = 48000
        self._channels = 2
        # Блок чтения 0.25 c, а не 1 c: поток захвата замечает _running=False
        # и завершается за четверть секунды (иначе он переживал stop() и
        # копился при каждом старте), плюс аудио попадает в STT быстрее.
        self._chunk_sec = 0.25
        self._audio_callbacks = []  # list of callables(audio, sample_rate)
        self._proc_capture = None
        self._capture_thread = None
        self._capture_threads = []
        # «Поколение» захвата. Потоки петли застревают внутри
        # stream.read() (C-уровень, извне их не прервать) и переживают
        # stop(). Если они продолжают звать колбэки, то после N
        # перезапусков одна реплика попадает в STT N раз. Поэтому поток
        # знает своё поколение и молчит, если поколение устарело.
        self._gen = 0

def start(self, game_pid=None, force_loopback=False):
        """Начать захват аудио.

        1) Пытаемся захватить ТОЛЬКО выбранный/авто-определённый процесс
           (наш собственный TTS тогда физически не попадает в запись).
        2) Если не вышло — системный WASAPI loopback.
        """
        if self._running:
            # Явный выбор exe важнее текущего авто-захвата: переключаемся
            if game_pid is not None and self._auto_target \
                    and self._proc_capture_pid() != game_pid:
                self._game_name = self._name_of_pid(game_pid) or self._game_name
                self._switch_capture_to(game_pid)
            return

        self._auto_target = game_pid is None
        if game_pid is not None:
            self._game_pid = game_pid
        else:
            game = self.find_game_process()
            if game:
                self._game_pid = game["pid"]
                self._game_name = game["name"]
            else:
                logger.warning("[GameAudio] No active audio source found, "
                               "capturing all system audio")

        if self._vbcable_enabled:
            self._switch_to_vbcable()

        if (self.per_process_enabled and not force_loopback and self._game_pid
                and PROC_CAP_AVAILABLE and proc_cap_mod.is_supported()):
            if self._start_process_capture(self._game_pid):
                self._running = True
                self._start_auto_monitor()
                return

        if not self._start_loopback_capture():
            self._stop_streams()
            if self._vbcable_enabled:
                self._restore_default_output()
            return

        self._running = True
        self._start_auto_monitor()

## Scope framing

I could not see the original list of seven points verbatim, so I have organized the findings by the seven subsystems they map to: (1) live-mode architecture, (2) OCR live pipeline, (3) audio capture, (4) STT, (5) subtitle fallback, (6) servers + PWA, (7) code quality / platform viability. Everything below is verified by direct read.

---

# 1. Live-mode architecture and entry points

**Only one launcher is real.** `main.py:14` imports `gui_compact.CompactWindow`. Nothing imports `gui.py` or `gui_mort.py`.

- `gui_mort.py` has **no `if __name__ == "__main__"` block** (0 matches) — it is entirely unreachable dead code, yet it holds the only STT config wiring (see §1.3).
- `gui.py` has a `__main__` block, so it is runnable as `python gui.py`, but it is not the shipped entry point.
- `run_voice.py`, `live_launch.py`, `live_dialog_player.py`, `server_pro.py`, `mini_server.py` each have `__main__` blocks (standalone).

## 1.1 Two distinct "live" paths in the real GUI

| Path | Trigger | Code |
|---|---|---|
| OCR live scan | `btn_live` click | `gui_compact.py:124` → `_on_live_toggle` `gui_compact.py:1138-1146` |
| Auto-Read (scan **+** audio/STT) | `F7` / Speak button | `gui_compact.py:1159-1240` start, `1241-1305` stop |

`_on_live_toggle` (`gui_compact.py:1138-1146`) only calls `self.scanner.start()` / `stop()`. It does **not** start audio/STT. Auto-Read is the path that wires `VoiceTranslator`.

## 1.2 Audio/STT wiring in the real launcher

`gui_compact.py:1222-1237`:

```
voice_translator.tts = self.tts            # 1228
set_languages(audio_lang, "ru")            # 1230/1232
set_dual_mode(dual)                        # 1233
set_vad(vad)                               # 1234
on_voice_detected = <GUI status pulse>     # 1235-1236
voice_translator.start()                   # 1237
```

Gated by `audio_lang = settings.get("game.audio_language", "auto")` (`gui_compact.py:1221`); if `"off"`, audio never starts.

Note `gui_compact.py:1204-1206`: `start_tts_streaming()` is only scheduled if `loop.is_running()` — inside a Qt slot the default `asyncio.get_event_loop()` has no running loop, so this is wrapped in `except Exception: pass` and **silently does nothing** on most paths. Same pattern at `1274-1279` for stop.

## 1.3 Dead configuration (significant finding)

`gui_compact.py` **never** calls `set_model`, `set_chunk_duration`, or `set_stt_tts_rate`:

```
$ grep -n "set_model\|set_chunk_duration\|set_stt_tts_rate\|per_process\|GameAudioCapture" gui_compact.py
NONE FOUND
```

The only reader of the `stt.*` config block is dead code:

- `gui_mort.py:2778` — `voice_translator.set_model(settings.get("stt.whisper_model", "tiny"))`
- `gui_mort.py:2779` — `set_chunk_duration(settings.get("stt.chunk_duration", 1.0))`
- `gui_mort.py:2780` — `set_stt_tts_rate(settings.get("stt.tts_rate", 0))`
- `gui_mort.py:2816-2818` — same three, second call site
- `gui_mort.py:231-232` — `game_audio.per_process_enabled = bool(settings.get("stt.per_process_capture", False))`

Therefore, in the shipped app (`main.py` → `gui_compact.py`), these `config.example.json` keys are **inert**:

| Config key | `config.example.json` | Effective value |
|---|---|---|
| `stt.whisper_model` | `:119` `"base"` | `"tiny"` (`voice_translator.py:56`) |
| `stt.chunk_duration` | `:120` `0.2` | `3.0` s (`voice_translator.py:57`) |
| `stt.tts_rate` | `:121` `0` | internal default |
| `stt.per_process_capture` | `:122` `false` | hardcoded `True` (`game_audio_capture.py:67`) |

The `chunk_duration` gap is the most user-visible: the config asks for 0.2 s responsiveness, the app delivers 3 s.

## 1.4 Launcher hardening (good)

`main.py:99-110` monkey-patches `threading.Thread.__init__` so daemon-thread crashes are logged instead of vanishing. `main.py:131-150` adds a 12 s GUI hang watchdog that dumps all thread stacks to `hang_trace.txt`.

# 2. `live_scanner.py` — OCR live pipeline

`LiveScanner(ScreenScanner)` at `live_scanner.py:13,21`. Method inventory:

Async TTS tasks are created at `live_scanner.py:397, 399, 824, 871, 981`; the coroutines are `start_tts_streaming` (`:760`) and `stop_tts_streaming` (`:766`).

## 2.1 Confirmed runtime bug: missing `threading` import

Imports at `live_scanner.py:5-13`:

```
5:  import asyncio
6:  import collections
7:  import logging
8:  import os
9:  import re
10: import time
11: from typing import Optional, Callable
13: from scanner import ScreenScanner
```

`threading` is absent, yet it is used twice:

- `live_scanner.py:327` — `threading.Thread(target=self._speak_chunk, ...)` inside `_process_punct_stream`, nested in `try:` at `:321` / `except Exception as e:` at `:332`
- `live_scanner.py:350` — same call inside `_check_punct_idle`, `try:` at `:347` / `except Exception as e:` at `:355`

**Effect:** punctuation mode always raises `NameError: name 'threading' is not defined`, and because the `NameError` is raised *after* translation already succeeded (`:322-324`), it is caught and logged as a translation failure at `:333`:

```
logger.error(f"[PUNCT] Ошибка перевода: {e}")
```

This produces a doubly misleading log — the translation was fine, the speech never fires. Punct-mode TTS is non-functional. Fix is a one-line `import threading`.

## 2.2 Per-chunk event loop

`_speak_chunk` (`live_scanner.py:359-366`) calls `asyncio.new_event_loop()` per chunk and `loop.close()`. This spawns/destroys a loop for every spoken fragment; on Windows with `pywin32`/SAPI audio output this is a recurring source of COM apartment churn, and the loop is not installed as the thread's current loop before `run_until_complete`.

## 2.3 Silero is TTS-only

`live_scanner.py:694-695` references Silero inside voice *classification* for TTS voice selection. It is not part of the STT chain. STT is `faster-whisper` only (§4).

---

# 3. `game_audio_capture.py` — WASAPI audio capture

Module-level singleton, constructed with no arguments:

```
game_audio_capture.py:811: game_audio = GameAudioCapture()
```

## 3.1 Optional-import guards (good, and Linux-safe)

```
17-21: import pyaudiowpatch as pyaudio   → PYAUDIO_AVAILABLE
23-27: from pycaw.pycaw import AudioUtilities → PYCAW_AVAILABLE
29-33: import process_audio_capture as proc_cap_mod → PROC_CAP_AVAILABLE
```

`process_audio_capture` is guarded with `except Exception` (`:32`), so it imports cleanly where `comtypes` is missing.

## 3.2 Capture parameters

- `_sample_rate = 48000`, `_channels = 2` — `game_audio_capture.py:49-50`
- `_chunk_sec = 0.25` — `game_audio_capture.py:54`, with a comment explaining that 1 s blocks caused threads to survive `stop()`; 0.25 s keeps native `stream.read()` loops responsive to `_running = False`.
- `_silence_threshold = 0.005`, `_voice_threshold = 0.01` — `game_audio_capture.py:77-78`
- `_audio_callbacks` list — `game_audio_capture.py:55`
- **Generation counter** `_gen` — `game_audio_capture.py:64`: threads stuck in C-level `stream.read()` cannot be interrupted, so they outlive `stop()` and would deliver the same utterance N times after N restarts; each thread carries its generation and goes silent when stale. This is a well-designed mitigation for a real WASAPI failure mode.

## 3.3 Per-process capture is permanently dead code

This is the most important finding in the audio layer. Three independent facts converge:

**(a) The config toggle is orphaned.** `per_process_enabled = True` is hardcoded at `game_audio_capture.py:67`. The only assignment from config is `gui_mort.py:231-232`, which is unreachable (§1.3).

**(b) The support gate can never be true.** `game_audio_capture.py:478-479`:

```
if (self.per_process_enabled and not force_loopback and self._game_pid
        and PROC_CAP_AVAILABLE and proc_cap_mod.is_supported()):
```

`process_audio_capture.py:183-210`:

```
23:  EXPERIMENTAL_SETCLIENTPROPERTIES = False
...
202: if not EXPERIMENTAL_SETCLIENTPROPERTIES:
203:     return False
204: if not COMTYPES_AVAILABLE:
205:     return False
```

`EXPERIMENTAL_SETCLIENTPROPERTIES` is a module constant, never reassigned anywhere in the repo, and is `False`. `is_supported()` therefore **returns `False` unconditionally on every platform**. Its own docstring admits this at `process_audio_capture.py:199-200`: *"Пока это не реализовано, честно отвечаем False и работаем через системный loopback"* ("while this is unimplemented, we honestly return False and work via system loopback").

**(c) The fallback implementation is the known-broken one.** `ProcessLoopbackCapture._run` (`process_audio_capture.py:286-378`) still uses `IAudioClient2` + `AudioClientProperties.bIsProcessLoopback` + `SetClientProperties` at `:300-309`. The `is_supported()` docstring at `process_audio_capture.py:186-189` states this exact path is broken: *there is no such field in the SDK, and the IID was wrong, so COM answered "Class not registered"*. The correct approach (`ActivateAudioInterfaceAsync` with `VIRTUAL_AUDIO_DEVICE_PROCESS_LOOPBACK`) is described in the docstring at `:191-197` but **never implemented** — no `ActivateAudioInterfaceAsync` call exists in the file.

**Net effect:** `GameAudioCapture.start()` always falls through `:478-483` to `_start_loopback_capture()` at `:485`. The class is fully exercised but can never succeed. This is the feature that would have made STT immune to the app's own TTS; instead, all echo suppression is load-bearing on the §4.4 heuristics.

The 811-line file, the C# source, and the `ScreenOcrNative.dll` all exist to serve a capability that is switched off in code. The only implementation that would actually work is the unreferenced C# one (`native/ProcessLoopbackCapture.cs`, which uses `ActivateAudioInterfaceAsync` and targets Windows 10 build 20348+ / Win11).

Note also a version inconsistency: the Python docstring gates on build `>= (10, 19041)` (`:208`, i.e. 2004) while the working C# requires 20348+.

## 3.4 Game process discovery

Generic heuristics, no game-specific support:

- `_AUDIO_DENYLIST` — `game_audio_capture.py:83-91`: `python`, `explorer`, `audiodg`, `svchost`, browsers, media players, `discord`, `steam`, `obs`, etc.
- `_GAME_HINTS` — `game_audio_capture.py:94-101`: `game`, `genshin`, `honkai`, `wuthering`, `eldenring`, `cyberpunk`, `unity`, `unreal`, `godot`, `starrail`, `zzz`, `pgr`, `arknights`, `warframe`, `apex`, `pubg`, `tarkov`, `stalker`, `fnaf`, …
- `find_game_process` — `game_audio_capture.py:247-258`, returns early when `PYCAW_AVAILABLE` is false (`:258`)
- 3 s auto-monitor that re-targets the capture — `game_audio_capture.py:329-355`
- Health check with 5 s grace and 300 s failure backoff — `game_audio_capture.py:69-70, 525-558`; the comment at `:526-531` explains that an earlier volume-based check produced false fallbacks during in-game silence, which is correct reasoning.

## 3.5 `force_loopback` is never used

`start(self, game_pid=None, force_loopback=False)` — `game_audio_capture.py:448`. The only caller, `voice_translator.py:457`, invokes `game_audio.start(game_pid=target)` and never passes `force_loopback`. Moot given §3.3, but it confirms the per-process path was intended to be escapable and is not.

---

# 4. `voice_translator.py` — STT pipeline

STT engine is **`faster-whisper`**. `WhisperModel(...)` at `voice_translator.py:396`; `transcribe` at `:1073`. There is no Silero VAD for STT — `set_vad` (`:210`) gates an energy-based VAD, and Silero appears only in TTS voice classification.

## 4.1 Startup sequence

`voice_translator.py:404-476`:

- `:411` preload offline translation dictionary
- `:414-415` attach module singleton `game_audio`
- `:417` `find_game_process()`; logs a warning and falls back to all-system audio if none found (`:421`)
- `:422-446` `on_audio` callback with **unbounded backlog** and a real drop threshold: the comment at `:423-429` documents a previous design that dropped the oldest audio when the queue filled, losing replies outright. Now the queue accumulates and only discards when `_audio_backlog_sec > _audio_max_backlog_sec` (`:434`), counting `_audio_dropped` (`:440`).
- `:447` `game_audio.add_audio_callback(on_audio)`
- `:452-457` targeted restart: stops the capture only when an explicit PID differs from the current one, with the comment at `:448-451` that restarting a live loopback read-thread causes a native crash
- `:465-467` `_last_voice_at` seeded to now so the subtitle fallback does not fire instantly at startup
- `:470-471` Whisper loaded in a background thread (`_spawn('whisper-load', ...)`); comment at `:464-466` notes synchronous load froze the UI on a torch spike

`_ensure_whisper` at `:387-401`; `_load_whisper_bg` at `:473-479`, which only starts `stt-loop` after a successful load.

## 4.2 Translation and worker supervision

- Translation dispatched to a worker queue with futures — `voice_translator.py:700-711`
- Workers respawned on failure — `voice_translator.py:713+` (invoked with `restart=True` at `:474`)

## 4.3 Segmenting / batching

Silence- and duration-driven segmentation lives in `_process_loop` (spawned at `:474`). Configured chunk length `_chunk_duration = 3.0` at `voice_translator.py:57`, with the inline comment *"3s for full sentences"* — i.e. the design trades latency for sentence completeness, and the config's 0.2 s never applies.

Tests covering this area: `test_stt_segmentation.py`, `test_realtime_segments.py`, `test_streaming_chunks.py`, `test_dual_sync.py`, `test_sentence_mode.py`.

## 4.4 Echo guard — two independent layers

Because per-process capture is dead (§3.3), the app's own TTS is captured by the system loopback, so echo suppression is entirely heuristic:

**Layer 1 — time gate + ducking**
- `_tts_playing` flag — `voice_translator.py:129`
- `_duck_volume = 0.3` — `voice_translator.py:133`
- `_echo_until` deadline — checked at `voice_translator.py:568`, which drops audio while `self._tts_playing or time.time() < self._echo_until`
- Game volume ducked before speaking — `voice_translator.py:1403-1409` (only when `game_audio.is_isolated()` is true, `:1403-1404`); sets `_tts_playing = True` at `:1415`
- Playback bounds polled from the TTS engine's own timestamps — `voice_translator.py:1465-1474` using `tts.playback_started_at` / `tts.playback_ended_at` (initialized `tts_engine.py:192-193`, set in `_play_audio` at `tts_engine.py:898, 901, 906`)
- Original volume restored — `voice_translator.py:1482-1484`
- `_tts_playing` cleared in `finally` — `voice_translator.py:1492`

**Layer 2 — text similarity**
- `_recent_ru = deque(maxlen=16)` holds the app's own last 16 spoken Russian strings — `voice_translator.py:134`
- Appended when speaking — `voice_translator.py:1374`
- Whisper results compared against it and suppressed — `voice_translator.py:315`

`test_echo_guard.py` exercises both layers, and its header documents the two-level design.

## 4.5 Shutdown hygiene (good)

`voice_translator.py:478-505`:

- docstring at `:479-480` states it must never raise, because it is called both from the GUI teardown and from a `finally` in `run_voice`
- cancels `_flush_timer` — `:484-489`
- removes the audio callback and only stops the shared capturer when no callbacks remain — `:489-500`, using `getattr` defensively with a comment at `:494-495` about not coupling to a private attribute
- closes the `SubtitleReader`, with a comment at `:503-505` noting that **mss holds GDI handles that accumulated across frequent start/stop cycles** — a real leak that was found and fixed

---

# 5. `subtitle_reader.py` — what it actually does

**It is not a subtitle-file reader.** It contains no `.srt` / `.ass` / `.vtt` handling, no file open of any subtitle format, and no game-specific knowledge. It is a second OCR pass over the lower band of the target game's window, used as a fallback when STT hears nothing.

| Method | Line | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `__init__` | 44 | `region_ratio=(0.06, 0.66, 0.88, 0.17)` — bottom ~17% band, horizontally inset 6%/12% |
| `_auto_pid` | 80 | auto-detect target PID |
| `_find_hwnd` | 94 | window lookup |
| `_window_rect` | 142 | |
| `_ensure_ocr` | 164 | lazy OCR init |
| `_band` | 186 | band geometry |
| `_is_foreground` | 212 | gate on focus |
| `close` | 251 | release mss |
| `is_active` | 268 | |
| `_auto_region` | 282 | auto-fit the band to detected text |
| `set_regions` | 354 | |
| `_boxes` | 381 | |
| `_sct` | 391 | mss singleton |
| `_grab` | 403 | capture |
| `_refresh_region` | 452 | |
| `_looks_like_text` | 472 | reject UI noise |
| `_ensure_fast_ocr` | 493 | lightweight OCR |
| `_recognize` | 520 | |
| `read` | 535 | main entry |
| `current_age` / `current` | 594 / 604 | `current(max_age=3.0)` — 3 s staleness window |

Dedupe via `_norm` (`:25`) and a `last_text` comparison at `:587-590`; `last_text` reset at `:377`. Wired into the pipeline at `voice_translator.py:462-464`.

**Answering the "which files/formats, which games" question directly:** none and none. Games are identified only generically through PID/window discovery, and the only game names anywhere in this subsystem are the heuristic hint strings in `game_audio_capture.py:94-101`.

---

# 6. Servers and PWA

Three overlapping HTTP servers, with **conflicting default ports**.

| Server | Default | Bind | Entry | Docstring |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `web_tts_server.py` | 8765 | `127.0.0.1` | GUI-integrated class | `:3-20` |
| `server_pro.py` | 8074 | `127.0.0.1` (`0.0.0.0` w/ `--public`) | `__main__` | `:1-7` |
| `mini_server.py` | 8765 | — | `__main__` | `:1-19` |

`web_tts_server.py` and `mini_server.py` both default to **8765**. Separately, `config.example.json:114-117` sets `web_tts.port = 8074`, which collides with `server_pro.py`'s default **8074**.

## 6.1 `web_tts_server.py` routes (GUI-integrated, port 8765)

`do_GET` → `_do_GET_inner` at `web_tts_server.py:696-736`:

| Route | Line | Handler |
|---|---|---|
| `/` | 699-700 | inline `MANUAL_PAGE` (SAPI) |
| `/live` | 701-702 | inline `LIVE_PAGE` (browser Web Speech) |
| `/control` | 703-704 | serves `web/index.html` from disk (`:800-807`) |
| `/manifest.json` | 705-706 | |
| `/sw.js` | 707-708 | |
| `/icon-*.png` | 709-710 | via `_serve_static` |
| `/qr` | 711-712 | |
| `/events` | 713-714 | SSE |
| `/voices` | 715-716 | SAPI + Edge list |
| `/health` | 717-718 | |
| `/regions` | 719-720 | |
| `/region_screenshot/*` | 721-722 | |
| `/audio/<f>` | 723-724 | basename-sanitized |
| `/api/status` | 725-726 | |
| `/api/settings` | 727-728 | |
| `/api/windows` | 729-730 | |
| `/api/live/status` | 731-732 | |
| `/api/regions` | 733-734 | |
| else | 735-736 | 404 JSON |

`do_POST` → `_do_POST_inner` at `web_tts_server.py:748-798`:
`/speak` (750), `/scan` (768), `/ocr_image` (777), `/api/settings` (779), `/api/window/select` (781), `/api/window/clear` (783), `/api/live/start` (785), `/api/live/stop` (787), `/api/tts/stop` (789), `/api/ocr/scan` (791), `/api/region/save` (793), `/api/region/delete` (795), else 404 (797-798).

Both `do_GET` (`:686-694`) and `do_POST` (`:738-746`) wrap the inner dispatcher in a catch-all that logs and returns a 500 JSON. Path parsing is `unquote(urlparse(self.path).path)` (`:698`).

Globals: `_subtitle_clients` + `_subtitle_lock`, `_ocr_result_clients` + `_ocr_result_lock` (`:38-52`). The SSE handler at `:822-848` multiplexes two queues into one stream — `event: subtitle` (`:842`) and `event: ocr_result` (`:848`).

**GUI integration** (`gui.py`, reachable only in the alternate launcher): `register_gui_callbacks({...})` at `gui.py:1572-1581` binds `start_live`, `stop_live`, `force_stop_tts`, `is_live_running`, `is_ocr_ready`, `select_window`, `clear_window`, `get_ocr`. This is what makes `/api/live/*` functional — and it is registered **only** from `gui.py:1564`, never from `gui_compact.py`. In the shipped app, `web_tts_server`'s `/api/live/*` and `/api/window/*` routes have no callbacks registered. Another dead-code consequence of the `gui.py` orphan.

TTS: `speak_engine` (`:145-157`) does Edge first, falling back to SAPI (`:154-155`), with a forced-SAPI branch at `:157`. On non-Windows only the Edge path can succeed.

## 6.2 `server_pro.py` routes (headless, port 8074)

`do_OPTIONS` (`:192-198`) with permissive CORS. `do_GET` at `:200-250`: `/` and `/index.html` (`:202-204`), `/web/*` (`:205-222` with a content-type switch), `/manifest.json` (`:223-225`), `/sw.js` (`:226-228`), `/health` (`:229-239`), `/voices` (`:240-242`), `/events` SSE (`:243-245`), `/audio/<f>` (`:246-249`), else 404 (`:250`).

`do_POST` at `:289-327`: `/ocr_image` (`:291-295`), `/translate` (`:296-309`), `/speak` (`:310-326`), else 404 (`:327`).

SSE at `:256-287`: registers into `_subtitle_clients` (`:264-265`), emits `event: subtitle` (`:273`) and `: ping` heartbeats (`:276`), and always deregisters in `finally` (`:282-287`). Content-type mapping for audio at `:252-254`.

Note `:230` — `global _ocr_ready` is declared but `_ocr_ready` is only read at `:234`, never assigned in this scope. Harmless, but the flag can only be set by the module's own init.

## 6.3 `mini_server.py` routes (phone companion, port 8765)

`do_GET` at `:129-216`: `/health` (`:132-133`), `/voices` (`:135-136`), `/events` (`:138-174`), `/live` (`:176-201`, inline HTML with `speechSynthesis` at `:193-197`), `/audio/<f>` (`:203-214`), else 404 (`:215-216`). `do_POST` at `:218-234`: only `/speak` (`:219`), with a `synthesize_sapi` call at `:229`.

`mini_server.py` serves no `index.html`, `manifest.json`, or `sw.js` — the PWA is impossible against it. It also hardcodes `Content-Type: audio/wav` at `:209` regardless of actual file extension.

Phone-connection lifecycle: `phone_connected` event set on first SSE (`:139-141`), which arms a `threading.Timer(TIMEOUT_AFTER_CONNECT, on_timeout)` (`:144`).

## 6.4 PWA — real, and currently broken

`web/index.html` links the manifest at `:8` and registers the service worker at `:373` (`navigator.serviceWorker.register("/sw.js").catch(()=>{})` — the empty catch hides registration failure). `web/manifest.json` is a valid standalone portrait PWA declaring `/icon-192.png` and `/icon-512.png` (`:12-21`). Both icons exist in `web/`.

`web/sw.js` bypass rules at `:25-26` correctly exclude `/api/*`, `/events`, and `/audio/*` from cache-first handling — a good decision for live data.

**Bug: the service worker cannot install against either server that ships it.**

`web/sw.js:3-9` pre-caches:

```js
const ASSETS = ["/", "/index.html", "/manifest.json", "/sw.js", "/icon-192.png"];
```

`cache.addAll` (`:12`) rejects if **any** response is not 2xx, which aborts the whole `install` event.

- **Against `web_tts_server`:** there is no `/index.html` route. The full GET table is `web_tts_server.py:699-736`; `index.html` is served only at `/control` (`:703-704`, handler `:800-807`). `/index.html` therefore returns the 404 JSON at `:735-736`, `addAll` rejects, and the worker never activates. (`/icon-192.png` would have worked — `_serve_static` resolves relative to `web/` at `:811`.)
- **Against `server_pro`:** `/index.html` works (`:202-204`) and `/manifest.json` / `/sw.js` work (`:223-228`), but there is no root-level `/icon-192.png` route — static files are only served under the `/web/` prefix (`:205-222`), so the request falls through to the 404 at `:250`. `addAll` rejects again.

Second defect: the fetch handler at `sw.js:30-33` caches **any** response without checking `res.ok`, so 404 JSON error bodies get written into the cache. The offline fallback `caches.match("/index.html")` (`:34`) compounds this — under `web_tts_server` that key can never be populated even in principle.

**Client/server mismatch:** `web/index.html` sets `BASE = location.origin` (`:149`) and calls only `/health` (`:173`), `/voices` (`:185`), `/ocr_image` (`:255`, `:271`), `/translate` (`:279`, `:326`), `/speak` (`:287`, `:308`), and `/events` (`:347`). It uses **none** of `web_tts_server`'s `/api/*` routes. So `web/index.html` is a client for `server_pro`/`mini_server`, not for `web_tts_server`'s `/control` panel — despite `web_tts_server.py:800-807` serving exactly that file at `/control`.

## 6.5 `net_monitor.py`

Probes Google Translate on a 6 s interval and buckets latency into `fast` (≤1.5 s), `slow` (≤4 s), `offline` otherwise — `net_monitor.py:16-19`, `:34-45`. Intended to drive cloud/offline engine selection.

## 6.6 Dependency gap

`requirements.txt` is 32 lines and covers GUI, OCR, TTS, voice changer, hotkeys, spellcheck. It lists **none** of the audio/STT runtime dependencies:

- `pyaudiowpatch` (required by `game_audio_capture.py:18`)
- `pycaw` (`:24`)
- `comtypes` (required by `process_audio_capture`)
- `faster-whisper` (required by `voice_translator.py:396`)

All four are behind optional guards, so nothing crashes at import — but a fresh `pip install -r requirements.txt` yields an app whose entire audio/STT half is inert with no installation error to explain why.

---

# 7. Code quality and platform viability

## 7.1 No bare `except:`

Verified across all eight in-scope files — **zero** bare excepts:

```
live_scanner.py            bare=0
voice_translator.py        bare=0
game_audio_capture.py      bare=0
process_audio_capture.py   bare=0
subtitle_reader.py         bare=0
web_tts_server.py          bare=0
server_pro.py              bare=0
mini_server.py             bare=0
```

Broad `except Exception` is used instead, with counts: `voice_translator.py` 29, `web_tts_server.py` 22, `game_audio_capture.py` 17, `process_audio_capture.py` 6, `live_scanner.py` 5, `server_pro.py` 5, `subtitle_reader.py` 4, `mini_server.py` 4. In the network/server code this is correct (a handler thread must not die); in `voice_translator.py` it is heavy enough to mask real failures, as §2.1 demonstrates.

## 7.2 Linux viability

Every Windows dependency is import-guarded, so the modules import cleanly and nothing raises at import time. Behavior degrades silently rather than loudly:

- `pyaudiowpatch` absent → `PYAUDIO_AVAILABLE = False` (`game_audio_capture.py:21`) → `_start_loopback_capture` returns `False` at `:577-579` → `start()` calls `_stop_streams()` (`:486`) and returns with `_running` still `False`.
- But `voice_translator.start()` sets `self._running = True` unconditionally at `voice_translator.py:458` and spawns the Whisper loader at `:470-471`. The STT loop runs against an audio queue that will never receive a sample, with no user-visible error.
- `pycaw` absent → `find_game_process` returns early (`:258`) → all-system-audio warning path (`:472-473`).
- SAPI unavailable → `web_tts_server.speak_engine` can only use the Edge branch (`:145-157`).
- `live_launch.py:12-17` calls `ctypes.windll` inside a `try` that swallows the resulting `AttributeError`, so the import survives on Linux and the hardcoded `HWND_GAME = 787670` (`:28`) is meaningless.

`live_launch.py` is additionally a single-game script, not a general live mode: fixed window handle 787670, `SCAN_MS = 400` (`:28-29`), and MD5-based spoken-text dedup (`:29-64`).

## 7.3 Prioritized defect list

| # | Severity | Finding | Location |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | High | Punct-mode TTS never speaks; `threading` not imported, `NameError` swallowed and logged as a translation error | `live_scanner.py:5-13` vs `:327`, `:350` |
| 2 | High | Per-process capture permanently disabled; `is_supported()` returns `False` unconditionally, and the only implementation is the known-broken COM path | `process_audio_capture.py:23, 183-210, 300-309`; `game_audio_capture.py:67, 478-479` |
| 3 | High | `stt.whisper_model`, `stt.chunk_duration`, `stt.tts_rate`, `stt.per_process_capture` all inert — only reader is unreachable `gui_mort.py` | `gui_mort.py:231-232, 2778-2780, 2816-2818` |
| 4 | High | Service worker install always fails against both servers (`/index.html` 404 on one, `/icon-192.png` 404 on the other) → no offline PWA | `web/sw.js:3-12`; `web_tts_server.py:699-736`; `server_pro.py:205-250` |
| 5 | Medium | `web_tts_server` `/api/live/*` and `/api/window/*` have no callbacks in the shipped app (registration lives in dead `gui.py`) | `gui.py:1572-1581` |
| 6 | Medium | Port conflicts: `web_tts_server` 8765 = `mini_server` 8765; config `web_tts.port` 8074 = `server_pro` 8074 | `config.example.json:116`; `server_pro.py:332` |
| 7 | Medium | Service worker caches non-ok responses, poisoning the cache with 404 bodies | `web/sw.js:30-33` |
| 8 | Medium | Audio/STT dependencies absent from `requirements.txt`; silent degradation | `requirements.txt` vs `game_audio_capture.py:18, 24` |
| 9 | Low | `start_tts_streaming()` never scheduled from Qt slots (no running loop, exception swallowed) | `gui_compact.py:1204-1206, 1274-1279` |
| 10 | Low | New asyncio event loop per spoken chunk | `live_scanner.py:359-366` |
| 11 | Low | `global _ocr_ready` declared but never assigned | `server_pro.py:230` |
| 12 | Low | `audio/wav` hardcoded regardless of file type | `mini_server.py:209` |

**Items 1 and 3 are one-line fixes with outsized impact.** Item 1 is a single `import threading`; item 3 is copying six method calls from `gui_mort.py:2778-2780` into `gui_compact.py:1228`. Item 2 is a real feature implementation (the working C# in `native/ProcessLoopbackCapture.cs` would need a loader) and cannot be resolved by configuration.

parts.text:
Thoroughness: very thorough. Repo: /home/runner/hub-work/ScreenOCR_TTS/code (Screen OCR + TTS app).

Your job: analyze the ANDROID PORT, CI, TESTS, and REPO HYGIENE. Investigate:
1. android/ — read android/build.gradle.kts, android/settings.gradle.kts, android/app/build.gradle.kts, and all Kotlin sources under android/app/src/main. Is the Android app a real port of the Python app or a stub? What are the main Activities/classes? Is android/app/build and android/.gradle accidentally committed (they usually should be gitignored)? Run `git ls-files android | head -50` and count tracked build artifacts.
2. .github/workflows/build-apk.yml and pro-server.yml — what do they build/deploy? Is it valid (read them fully)? Any leaked secrets?
3. Tests: there are ~45 test_*.py files. Determine: are they pytest/unittest real automated tests, or ad-hoc manual scripts that just run at import? Sample at least 8 of them (test_full.py, test_integration.py, test_pipeline.py, test_components.py, test_ocr_engines_new.py, test_piper_integration.py, test_streaming_chunks.py, test_stress_restart.py). Report: how many would actually pass as automated tests, how many require a GUI/display, models, network, or Windows. Is there any pytest config (pytest.ini, pyproject.toml, setup.cfg, conftest.py)? Can the suite be run headless on Linux? Actually try running a couple of the most self-contained ones with a short timeout and report the real result (use timeout 60 and `python3 -m pytest --collect-only` or direct execution). Do NOT install packages.
4. Repo hygiene: run `git ls-files | wc -l`, `du -sh .git`, `git count-objects -vH`, and identify the largest tracked files (top 15 by size). Check .gitattributes. Note the committed binaries (yolov8n.pt 6.5MB, *.dll, jars, dex, apk artifacts?, model .tflite files) and whether that is a problem.
5. Is there a README? Any documentation, AGENTS.md, CONTRIBUTING, LICENSE? Run `ls -a` and check.
6. Summarize the overall commit history: `git log --oneline -30`, `git log --format='%an %ad %s' --date=short | head -20`, and how many commits total.

Do NOT write or modify any files. Return a structured text report with real command output numbers, dense with specifics.

parts.text:
So the Android app is a thin WebView wrapper — NOT a real port. It just loads a URL from a pro-server (the Python server exposed via cloudflare tunnel) inside a WebView. Only 1 Kotlin file, 166 lines, no OCR, no TTS native code.

Note: `android.enableJetifier=true` is deprecated in AGP 8 (it warns, and in AGP 8.2 it's still allowed but deprecated). Also `onBackPressed` is deprecated. Also there is no `local.properties` and no `google-services`. Also the AGP 8.2.2 vs Gradle 8.6 — AGP 8.2.2 supports Gradle 8.2+; Gradle 8.6 works with AGP 8.2? AGP 8.2 requires Gradle 8.2 minimum; higher Gradle versions generally work but AGP may complain. Actually AGP checks max version? AGP typically has a minimum Gradle version only. Gradle 8.6 with AGP 8.2.2 should work.

Also compileSdk 34 with AGP 8.2.2 — AGP 8.2 supports compileSdk 34. OK.

display.text:
name: ScreenOCR Pro Server

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      keep_alive_min:
        description: 'Сколько минут держать сервер (0 = пока процесс жив)'
        required: false
        default: '120'
        type: string
  repository_dispatch:
    types: [start-server]

env:
  PYTHON_VERSION: '3.12'

jobs:
  server:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 300
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: ${{ env.PYTHON_VERSION }}

      - name: Install server deps
        run: |
          pip install --quiet pillow numpy
          pip install --quiet edge-tts
          pip install --quiet rapidocr-onnxruntime
          pip install --quiet onnxruntime
          pip install --quiet requests
          sudo apt-get update -qq
          sudo apt-get install -y -qq libgl1 libglib2.0-0 >/dev/null 2>&1 || true

      - name: Install cloudflared (быстрый туннель)
        run: |
          mkdir -p /tmp/cf
          curl -fsSL "https://github.com/cloudflare/cloudflared/releases/latest/download/cloudflared-linux-amd64" -o /tmp/cf/cloudflared
          chmod +x /tmp/cf/cloudflared
          /tmp/cf/cloudflared --version

      - name: Start pro-server on :8074
        working-directory: ${{ github.workspace }}
        run: |
          nohup python server_pro.py --port 8074 --public > /tmp/server.log 2>&1 &
          echo "PID=$!"
          # ждём health
          for i in $(seq 1 60); do
            curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:8074/health && break
            sleep 1
          done
          echo "--- server.log ---"
          tail -5 /tmp/server.log

      - name: Start cloudflared tunnel
        id: tunnel
        run: |
          rm -f /tmp/cf_url.txt
          nohup /tmp/cf/cloudflared tunnel --url http://127.0.0.1:8074 --no-autoupdate > /tmp/cf.log 2>&1 &
          echo "cloudflared PID=$!"
          for i in $(seq 1 90); do
            URL=$(grep -oE "https://[a-z0-9-]+\.trycloudflare\.com" /tmp/cf.log | head -1 | tr -d '\r')
            if [ -n "$URL" ]; then
              echo "$URL" > /tmp/cf_url.txt
              break
            fi
            sleep 1
          done
          URL=$(cat /tmp/cf_url.txt 2>/dev/null || echo "")
          if [ -z "$URL" ]; then
            echo "Туннель не поднялся. cf.log:"; cat /tmp/cf.log
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "url=$URL" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo
          echo "=============================================="
          echo "  ПОДКЛЮЧЕНИЕ С ТЕЛЕФОНА (Web/PWA):"
          echo "  $URL"
          echo "=============================================="

      - name: Проверка публичного доступа
        run: |
          URL=$(cat /tmp/cf_url.txt)
          echo "Проверяем $URL/health ..."
          for i in $(seq 1 30); do
            if curl -fsS "$URL/health" >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "OK: сервер доступен публично"; break; fi
            sleep 2
          done
          curl -sS "$URL/health" | head -c 300 || echo " (!) публичный health не ответил"
          echo

      - name: Уведомление URL в summary
        run: |
          URL=$(cat /tmp/cf_url.txt)
          cat >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY" <<EOF
          ## 📱 ScreenOCR Pro Server запущен

          **URL для телефона (PWA):** [\`$URL\`]($URL)

          Открой этот адрес в браузере телефона (Chrome → "Добавить на главный экран").
          Или передай его в Android-приложение (ScreenOCR Client) на экране подключения.

          > Docker/runner вариант: сервер с полной проф-логикой (OCR, TTS Edge, перевод, cleaner) работает в этом workflow. Чтобы остановить — Cancel job.
          EOF

      - name: Ожидание (сервер жив)
        id: hold
        run: |
          url=$(cat /tmp/cf_url.txt)
          # keep alive loop, печатаем URL при изменениях
          if [ "${{ github.event.inputs.keep_alive_min }}" != "" ] && [ "${{ github.event.inputs.keep_alive_min }}" != "0" ]; then
            echo "Держим сервер ${{ github.event.inputs.keep_alive_min }} мин. URL: $url"
            sleep "$(( ${{ github.event.inputs.keep_alive_min }} * 60 ))"
          else
            echo "Сервер жив. URL: $url"
            echo "Остановите job (Cancel) когда закончите."
            while true; do
              if ! kill -0 $(pgrep -f "server_pro.py") 2>/dev/null; then
                echo "!!! server_pro.py умер:"; tail -30 /tmp/server.log; exit 1
              fi
              if ! pgrep -f cloudflared >/dev/null; then
                echo "!!! cloudflared умер:"; tail -30 /tmp/cf.log; exit 1
              fi
              sleep 30
            done
          fi

"""Full test suite for ScreenOCR_TTS"""
import os, sys, traceback
os.chdir(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))

passed = 0
failed = 0
errs = []

def test(name, func):
    global passed, failed

from voice_profiles import VoiceRouter, SUPPORTED_LANGUAGES, VoiceDictionary, VoiceProfile, MultiVoiceParser

def t_router_defaults():
    r = VoiceRouter()
    for lang in SUPPORTED_LANGUAGES:
        v = r.get_voice_for_language(lang)
        assert v, f"No voice for {lang}"
test("defaults", t_router_defaults)

def t_detect_ru():
    assert VoiceRouter().detect_language("Привет мир") == "ru"
test("detect ru", t_detect_ru)

def t_detect_en():
    assert VoiceRouter().detect_language("Hello world") == "en"
test("detect en", t_detect_en)

def t_detect_uk():
    assert VoiceRouter().detect_language("Привіт світ") == "ru"
test("detect uk (now ru)", t_detect_uk)

def t_set_voice():
    r = VoiceRouter()
    r.set_voice_for_language("en", "en-GB-SoniaNeural")
    assert r.get_voice_for_language("en") == "en-GB-SoniaNeural"
    r.set_voice_for_language("en", "en-US-GuyNeural")
test("set/get voice", t_set_voice)

def t_fallback():
    r = VoiceRouter()
    r.set_fallback_voice("ru-RU-SvetlanaNeural")
    assert r.get_fallback_voice() == "ru-RU-SvetlanaNeural"
    r.set_fallback_voice("ru-RU-DmitryNeural")
test("fallback", t_fallback)

def t_voice_for_text():
    r = VoiceRouter()
    v = r.get_voice_for_text("Привет")
    assert v.startswith("ru-RU-")
    v = r.get_voice_for_text("Hello")
    assert v.startswith("en-")
test("get_voice_for_text", t_voice_for_text)

# === 3. VOICE PROFILES ===
print("\n" + "=" * 60)
print("3. VOICE PROFILES")
print("=" * 60)

def t_vd_defaults():
    d = VoiceDictionary()
    assert len(d.profiles) > 0
test("VoiceDictionary defaults", t_vd_defaults)

def t_vd_get():
    d = VoiceDictionary()
    p = d.get_profile("Мужской")
    assert p.voice_code == "ru-RU-DmitryNeural"
test("VoiceDictionary get", t_vd_get)

def t_vd_set_remove():
    d = VoiceDictionary()
    d.set_profile("Test", "test-voice", rate=0.1, volume=0.9, language="ru")
    p = d.get_profile("Test")
    assert p.voice_code == "test-voice"
    assert p.rate == 0.1
    d.remove_profile("Test")
    assert d.get_profile("Test").name == "default"
test("VoiceDictionary set/remove", t_vd_set_remove)

def t_mvp():

    print('ТЕСТ 8: TTS просодия по типу предложения')
